jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
We're Hiring | Project Manager

Defense Training & Content Production
Location:
Remote / Flexible Workplace (United States)
Employment Type:
Full-Time
Work Schedule:
9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Eastern Time

Help Deliver Training That Matters.
At DVI Training Systems (DVITS), we develop advanced, video-based technical training solutions that prepare military personnel for mission-critical operations. Our work spans defense aviation, weapons and mission systems, unmanned systems, maritime operations, and other complex technical environments.
We're looking for an experienced, highly organized Project Manager
to help coordinate the people, processes, resources, and schedules behind our training development and production projects.
This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys managing complex work, building efficient systems, solving problems, and helping talented teams deliver exceptional results.

About the Role
As Project Manager, you'll coordinate training development projects from initial planning through final delivery, working closely with our Instructional Systems Design, Content Development, and Content Production teams.

You'll manage schedules, budgets, resources, Smartsheet workflows, and critical project logistics while maintaining clear communication with internal teams, outside subject matter experts, and customer stakeholders.

We're looking for someone who supports our teams in tracking and reporting progress, anticipating challenges and risks, taking initiative to manage change, and creating the structure needed to keep projects moving.

This position reports to our VP of Operations.

What You'll Do
·      Develop and manage comprehensive project plans, schedules, milestones, and deliverables.
·      Coordinate cross-functional teams, external subject matter experts, contractors, and project stakeholders.
·      Manage project schedules and dependencies across technical content development, instructional design, video production, customer reviews, and delivery.
·      Build, manage, and continuously improve project management workflows, dashboards, reports, and automations using Smartsheet
.
·      Track budgets, resource utilization, project expenses, and cost variances.
·      Coordinate project logistics for production and content capture activities, including travel arrangements, facilities, scheduling, and external participants.
·      Identify project risks, scheduling conflicts, resource constraints, and potential delays before they affect delivery.
·      Prepare accurate project reports and maintain clear communication with leadership and customer stakeholders.
·      Facilitate productive project meetings, planning sessions, and other Agile activities, such as retrospectives and after-action reviews.
·      Continually improve project management systems and operational processes.
·      Coordinate quality reviews, approvals, and final delivery requirements.

What We're Looking For
·      At least five years of professional project management experience.
·      Degree or certification in Project Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
·       Strong proficiency with Smartsheet
, including project schedules, dashboards, reports, workflow development, and automation.
·      Experience designing and maintaining effective project management systems.
·      Proven ability to manage multiple complex projects, schedules, budgets, and resources.
·      Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
·      Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
·      Experience applying Agile project management principles.
·      Ability to anticipate problems, recommend solutions, and work independently.
·      Professionalism, accountability, and a collaborative approach to teamwork.

Preferred Experience
·      Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
·      Experience in defense, aviation, government contracting, technical training, or multimedia production.
·      Experience coordinating video production, content development, instructional design, or other specialized creative and technical workflows.
·      Advanced Smartsheet administration, reporting, and workflow automation experience.

Work Arrangement
DVITS operates under a Flexible Workplace Policy. This position may be performed remotely from an approved U.S. work location; Atlanta residency is not required.

Employees must be available during regular working hours of 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time
and maintain a secure, professional working environment that meets company requirements.

Participation in scheduled company meetings and periodic in-person gatherings is required. Occasional business travel may be necessary.

Our philosophy is straightforward:
Flexibility changes where we work. It does not change the standards by which we work.

Why DVITS?
At DVITS, the work we do has purpose. Our training solutions help prepare military personnel to operate complex systems and perform in demanding environments.

You'll work alongside experienced professionals from military aviation, instructional design, technical training, and media production. You'll also have the opportunity to help shape and improve the systems that support our continued growth.

Our culture is grounded in a simple commitment:
Mission First. Excellence Always.℠

We value initiative, accountability, collaboration, and people who take pride in the quality of their work.

Export Control & Security Requirements
Due to potential access to export-controlled information, applicants must qualify as U.S. Persons under applicable export control regulations, including 22 C.F.R. § 120.62.
Employment is contingent upon completion of applicable background and security screenings. Additional government security requirements may apply to assigned projects.

How to Apply
Submit your resume and a cover letter describing your relevant project management and Smartsheet experience to: careers@dvitrainingsystems.com

DVI Training Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics and are committed to a professional, inclusive, and high-performing workplace.

jobs.title: Project Manager / Senior Project Manager - Renewable Energy
jobs.description:
Project Manager / Senior Project Manager - Renewable Energy

Confidential Renewable Energy Developer | Fully Remote | United States

I'm working with an established, rapidly growing renewable energy developer seeking experienced Project Managers and Senior Project Managers to join its Project Management team.

This is an opportunity to join a well-capitalized renewable energy company with a substantial nationwide portfolio of utility-scale solar, battery energy storage (BESS), and hybrid solar-plus-storage projects.

The company has nearly 22 GW of projects across 16 states and five electricity markets, with significant projects currently operational and under construction.

Position Overview

The Project Manager / Senior Project Manager will oversee utility-scale renewable energy projects from execution through construction, commissioning, and commercial operation (COD).

This person will work closely with EPC contractors, engineering teams, utilities, owner's engineers, consultants, and internal stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, and within budget.

The ideal candidate has experience managing projects from either the EPC or IPP/developer side, with particular interest in individuals who have experience on both sides of renewable energy project execution.

Key Responsibilities

Manage utility-scale solar, BESS, and hybrid renewable energy projects through construction and commercial operation.
Oversee EPC contractors, construction activities, project schedules, budgets, and overall execution.
Manage EPC contracts, change orders, claims, procurement, and contractor relationships.
Coordinate engineering, design reviews, equipment procurement, and construction planning.
Monitor project costs, forecasts, risks, quality, safety, and schedule performance.
Coordinate with utilities, owner's engineers, independent engineers, lenders, and other project stakeholders.
Oversee commissioning activities and support projects through COD.
Coordinate project documentation, invoicing, project finance requirements, and equipment deliveries.
Facilitate the transition of completed projects to operations and asset management teams.

Ideal Background

Approximately 5-7+ years of relevant experience for Project Manager candidates.
Approximately 8+ years of experience, including substantial direct IPP/developer project management experience, for Senior Project Manager candidates.
Experience managing utility-scale solar, battery storage, or hybrid renewable energy projects.
Background working for an EPC contractor, renewable energy developer/IPP, or both.
Demonstrated experience overseeing EPC contractors and construction execution.
Experience managing project budgets, schedules, contracts, procurement, and change orders.
Experience with preconstruction, construction, commissioning, and/or COD.
Ability to independently manage projects and coordinate multiple stakeholders.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related discipline.

Candidates with experience managing projects in the 100-350+ MW range are particularly attractive.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: $150,000-$190,000, depending on experience and level.
Annual bonus: 20%.
26 days of PTO.
13 company-paid holidays.
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.
Employer-sponsored disability and life insurance.
401(k) with employer matching.
Additional wellness and employee benefits.
Eligibility for the company's long-term incentive plan after two years, subject to plan requirements and award decisions.

No sign-on bonus is available.

Work Arrangement & Travel

Fully remote position.
Candidates located anywhere in the United States will be considered.
Eastern and Central time zones are preferred.
Pacific time zone candidates may be considered if comfortable working Eastern or Central business hours.
Approximately 2-3 days of travel per month, typically involving one project-site visit.
Additional travel may occasionally be required for significant project issues or emergencies.
Business travel expenses are reimbursed.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This is an opportunity to join a growing renewable energy developer with a substantial project pipeline and meaningful opportunities to contribute to project execution.

The organization operates with a relatively lean team, giving Project Managers meaningful ownership, visibility, and involvement across the project lifecycle.

The company is particularly interested in professionals who enjoy taking ownership of projects, managing EPC relationships, solving execution challenges, and delivering large-scale renewable energy projects.

Interested in learning more?
I'd welcome a confidential conversation to discuss your background, the opportunity, and whether it could be a good fit for your experience and career goals.

Desired Skills and Experience

Required Skills & Experience
5-7+ years of relevant project management or construction experience for Project Manager candidates; 8+ years for Senior Project Manager candidates, including substantial direct IPP/developer-side project management experience.
Experience managing utility-scale renewable energy projects, including solar, battery energy storage (BESS), and/or hybrid solar-plus-storage.
Background working for an EPC contractor, renewable energy developer/IPP, or ideally experience on both sides.
Demonstrated experience overseeing EPC contractors, construction activities, and overall project execution.
Strong understanding of project budgets, cost forecasting, schedules, contracts, procurement, change orders, and risk management.
Experience coordinating engineering teams, consultants, utilities, contractors, and other project stakeholders.
Exposure to multiple phases of the project lifecycle, including preconstruction, construction, commissioning, and commercial operation (COD).
Ability to independently manage project responsibilities, resolve execution challenges, and drive projects forward in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication, negotiation, organizational, and leadership skills.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related discipline.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience managing utility-scale projects of 100 MW or larger, particularly projects in the 250-350 MW range.
Experience transitioning from an EPC contractor into an IPP/developer-side project management role.
Experience managing standalone solar, standalone BESS, and/or hybrid renewable energy projects.
Direct ownership of EPC relationships, project budgets, schedules, commercial decisions, and overall project delivery.
Experience managing projects through NTP, construction, commissioning, and COD.
Familiarity with project finance requirements, independent engineers, owner's engineers, equipment procurement, and utility/interconnection coordination.
Experience working within a lean renewable energy development organization with significant individual project ownership.

Oscar Associates Limited (US) is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.

Planned Packaging of Illinois Corp. (PPOIC) is a national master distributor of packaging materials.The organization provides consolidation services,hold-to-release orders, and packaging consulting to help clients optimize their packaging operations. This position requires proactive leadership, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, geographically dispersed environment.

We partner with enterprise clients to deliver complex infrastructure projects, with expertise spanning Data Infrastructure, Low-Voltage Systems, Cybersecurity, Audio Visual, and Managed Services.

Our teams support projects from initial planning and coordination through construction, installation, testing, and final delivery. We take a hands-on, client-focused approach, emphasizing safety, quality, schedule performance, and successful project execution.

to support projects throughout the United States.

Position Overview The ideal candidate will have a strong background in construction project management, preferably within commercial construction, telecommunications, low-voltage infrastructure, or data center environments.

This individual will be responsible for managing projects from pre-construction planning through execution and closeout, ensuring projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with client expectations.

The Project Manager will work closely with field personnel, subcontractors, vendors, internal operations teams, and clients to coordinate resources, manage project schedules, oversee financial performance, and address challenges that may impact successful project delivery.

Success in this role requires a proactive, organized, and hands-on construction professional who can balance field execution with project financials, client communication, and operational coordination.

Responsibilities

Manage construction and infrastructure projects from initial planning and mobilization through execution, completion, and closeout.
Develop, maintain, and communicate project schedules, milestones, budgets, and resource requirements.
Coordinate daily construction activities with field supervisors, superintendents, subcontractors, vendors, and internal teams.
Oversee subcontractor performance, labor coordination, material procurement, and resource allocation to maintain project schedules.
Monitor project progress, identify potential delays or construction challenges, and implement corrective actions.
Conduct regular site visits to evaluate progress, address field issues, and ensure work is being completed according to project specifications.
Track project costs, labor hours, material expenses, revenue, and overall profitability.
Review project financials and provide regular updates on budgets, forecasts, cost variances, and financial performance.
Assist with preparing project estimates, proposals, scopes of work, and change orders, including labor and material cost assessments.
Coordinate material deliveries, equipment requirements, and subcontractor schedules to support construction milestones.
Maintain accurate project documentation, including schedules, daily reports, meeting notes, change orders, and closeout documentation.
Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, subcontractors, field teams, and internal management.
Lead project meetings and provide consistent updates regarding progress, outstanding issues, schedule changes, and resource needs.
Ensure all work meets applicable construction standards, client specifications, safety requirements, and ServicePoint quality expectations.
Identify opportunities to improve project execution, operational efficiency, and overall profitability.

Qualifications

3-5 years of experience managing construction, telecommunications, low-voltage, or data center infrastructure projects.
Experience coordinating field operations, subcontractors, labor resources, and material requirements.
Working knowledge of construction schedules, project budgets, labor forecasting, and cost management.
Understanding of low-voltage systems, structured cabling, fiber optics, telecommunications, and physical IT infrastructure.
Experience managing multiple projects, competing priorities, and changing project requirements.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Extraordinary Opportunity. Exceptional Experience.

Sometimes in life, you find yourself in the right place, at the right time, looking at an opportunity so extraordinary it cannot be ignored. At Trucordia, our company is built on wildly successful businesses in our communities across the country, and now we’ve come together to create the next great insurance brokerage. We offer an unrivaled combination of people, tools and solutions, and deliver exceptional experiences and opportunities for our employees, clients and stakeholders.

We celebrate both individual successes and collective accomplishments, making sure the industry recognizes the remarkable company we’re building together, as well as the impact we’re having on our clients and communities. Ranked as one of the fastest-growing companies in the U.S. for three consecutive years, we have more than 5,000 team members across 200 offices across the country, who actively, genuinely care about our clients, each other and the quality of our work, and in every interaction, represent a company that people want to work for and do business with.

Trucordia Values

We actively, genuinely CARE about our clients, each other and the quality of our work, and in every interaction, represent a company that people want to work for and do business with.
We COLLABORATE continuously because, together, we are more powerful and make amazing things happen for our clients and company.
We LEAD with intelligence, hunger, curiosity, energy and a future-focused attitude of “what’s next”?
We are RESULT-ORIENTED, growth-focused and driven to out-perform expectations of what an insurance brokerage can achieve.
We CELEBRATE both individual successes and collective accomplishments, making sure the industry recognizes the remarkable company we’re building together, as well as the impact we’re having on our clients and communities.

Job Description

Trucordia is seeking a Technical Program Manager to lead delivery for our Data & Analytics team. You'll own how work moves from business request to production: intake, prioritization, requirements, sprint execution, release, and adoption. You'll serve as the bridge between stakeholders in Finance, Accounting, Operations, Benefits, and the field, and the engineers and analysts who build our reports, integrations, automations, and data pipelines.

This role combines Agile delivery leadership, business analysis, and technical coordination. You'll be expected to understand the data work well enough to challenge estimates, spot dependency risks, and translate between technical and business audiences. You'll also use AI and automation to handle routine overhead like status reports, documentation drafts, and ticket hygiene, so your time goes to prioritization, stakeholder alignment, and risk management.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Program & Agile Delivery

Own end-to-end delivery across concurrent Data & Analytics initiatives, including program planning, sprint planning, standups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
Manage the intake-to-delivery workflow and program roadmap, keeping the backlog prioritized, groomed, and build-ready.
Track dependencies, risks, blockers, team capacity, and delivery metrics (velocity, cycle time, throughput, predictability), and act on what the data shows.
Maintain a program-level RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies), escalate appropriately, and drive mitigation plans.
Continuously improve team processes, ceremonies, and workflows.

Business Analysis & Requirements

Partner with business stakeholders to gather, document, and validate requirements.
Translate business needs into epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, and implementation plans, owning the accuracy of the final output.
Analyze current-state processes, identify improvement opportunities, and assess the downstream impact of changes to systems, data sources, and workflows.
Support evaluation of tools, technologies, and solution approaches through research and recommendations.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and the Data & Analytics team, aligning on priorities, timelines, and trade-offs.
Facilitate cross-functional and executive-level meetings and communicate program health clearly and consistently.
Coordinate releases, training, and change management so delivered solutions are adopted.
Provide regular reporting to leadership on progress, risks, and outcomes, using automated dashboards and reporting where possible.

Data Onboarding, Quality, & Documentation

Manage agency onboarding, data ingestion, and data migration as program workstreams, including milestones, dependencies, cutover planning, and data readiness.
Coordinate user acceptance testing and validate delivered work against requirements and data quality standards.
Maintain documentation, playbooks, runbooks, and knowledge-base content in Confluence or similar, keeping materials accurate and current.

Qualifications

5+ years of experience in technical program management, project management, Agile delivery, Scrum Master, or business analysis roles, including at least 3 years owning delivery for data, analytics, BI, or technical teams.

Why this role, and why now We've grown because talented people find a way to get things done. Now we're building the structure to go with that talent: a clear, repeatable path for every project from Sales → Project Management Office(PMO) → Design → Execution
, with defined ownership at each step.
We're hiring a Project Manager to help run that system and make it stick. You won't be the hero who rescues a project at the last minute. You'll be the person who makes those rescues unnecessary.
This could be the job for you if you value predictable delivery, clean handoffs and decisions written down, and you can keep a team moving while you introduce new ways of working.
What you'll own Project activation and handoffs

•    Bring new projects in through a formal activation process, and confirm the Sales handoff package is complete before work starts
•    Accept or return incomplete deliverables at each stage, and meet the same standard for what you hand to Design and Delivery
•    Make sure everyone understands the documented scope, schedule, budget and risks before execution begins
Scope and change control

•    Own project scope. Every change, including changes involving other trades, goes through a formal change order instead of being absorbed quietly
•    Work with Sales on the commercial impact of changes, and with Design on the technical impact
Planning, cost and schedule

•    Build and manage detailed schedules, work plans and budgets from the scope and the resources it needs
•    Track costs and progress against estimates, and raise variances early
•    Commit to completion dates you can keep, then protect them
Capacity and portfolio visibility

•    Run several large projects at once, and keep capacity, schedule and portfolio health visible at the PMO level
•    Contribute to the annual schedule and resource forecast
Quality and risk

•    Identify and track technical, compliance, financial and reputational risk, and escalate through defined paths
•    Log, report and resolve non-conformances (NCRs) accurately, including supplier-related issues
•    Cut down on return visits after a project is "done"
Communication and people

•    Give stakeholders regular, honest updates that cover what's going well as well as what isn't
•    Manage vendors and suppliers with clear tasks and expected deliverables
•    Work with Technical Project Supervisors to support technicians' career development and continuing education
•    Help define, measure and improve the KPIs we deliver against
Where you fit •     Sales
owns the client relationship and the commercial agreement
•     PMO (you)
owns scope, schedule, cost, change control and portfolio visibility
•     Technical Design
owns the solution design
•     Technical Project Supervisors
own site execution and direct the technicians
•     Technical Delivery Teams
build and commission the systems
You won't design systems or work on site with tools. You will need to understand the technology well enough to ask the right questions, spot risk early and judge whether a deliverable is really ready.
What success looks like In your first year you'll help us:
•    Run every new project through formal activation
•    Cut the number of completion-date changes
•    Reduce design changes found on site
•    Reduce escalations and emergency firefighting
•    Win more repeat work from existing clients
•    Run more projects at the same time without burning people out
You'll also help pilot this new delivery model before it rolls out across the company.
What you bring Required

•    Proven experience running several large projects at the same time with established project management practices, ideally in security, low-voltage, electrical or systems integration
•    A track record of formal change-order management, including coordination with other trades
•    Experience with project budgeting, scheduling and cost tracking
•    Working knowledge of networking, access control and video surveillance, enough to read drawings and assess technical risk
•    Security TQ
•    Clear, professional spoken and written English
Assets

•    PMP, CAPM or a similar designation, or formal project management education
•    FSR certification
•    Experience with stage gates, handoff standards or quality systems (for example ISO 9001)
•    Experience with NCR and corrective-action processes, and with KPI reporting
•    Ability to read and mark up AutoCAD drawings
•    Bilingual (English/French)
People who do well here

•    Would rather fix the process than fix the same problem twice
•    Stay calm and communicate steadily under pressure
•    Hold the line on scope, respectfully, with clients and with colleagues
•    Earn credibility with technicians and executives alike
What we offer •    Competitive salary ($95,000–$120,000, based on experience) and company health benefits
•    Company vehicle, cell phone and laptop
•    Paid training, certification and continuing education
•    A real say in how a growing company delivers its projects, and a career path that grows with it
Our standards Safety comes first, always. We expect respect, honesty, accountability, confidentiality and professional conduct from everyone, everywhere.
We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants regardless of gender, race or religion. Accommodations are available on request throughout the hiring process.
Conditions of employment •    Ability to pass multiple security background checks (local, provincial and federal)
•    Ability to pass pre-employment and annual drug and alcohol testing
•    Willingness to travel, sometimes on short notice
•    Professional communication, appearance and demeanour. Your calm confidence and knowledge should reassure clients
How to apply Send your resume and cover letter, both in PDF, to careers@unifiedsystems.ca .

jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY:

NineTwelve is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) to lead security management and compliance activities for information systems for a highly technical facility supporting Department of War operations. The ISSM will be responsible for ensuring systems are securely designed, implemented, operated, and maintained in accordance with organizational security policies, regulatory requirements, and applicable cybersecurity frameworks. Candidates must have an active Top Secret clearance . This position is on-site and is neither hybrid nor remote eligible.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

Implement the risk management framework for classified systems, typically following the Defense Counterintelligence Security Agency (DCSA), DAAG, or JSIG process and supporting communications with cognizant security authorities.
Serve as the primary point of contact for classified systems.
Produce and maintain Body of Evidence (BoE) documentation to include risk assessments, System Security Plan (SSP’s) and Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M’s).
Maintain the day-to-day security posture and continuous monitoring for all systems, including patching and updates.
Assist Information Security team in unclassified security operations, including continuous monitoring, incident response, and vulnerability management.
Assist Information Technology team in unclassified services functions.
Ensure all users have the requisite security clearances, authorization, need-to-know, and are aware of their security responsibilities before granting access to the information systems.
Ensures adherence to information system security policies and procedures.
Coordinate vulnerability management, security assessments, penetration testing, and remediation activities.
Performs oversight and provides guidance for media sanitization and destruction.
Confirms domain/local policies are configured to meet regulatory requirements.
Assesses changes to the system/operational needs that could affect its accreditation.
Voting/veto member of the CCB for all systems.
Assists with coordination between Kratos and Government authorities regarding system security posture requirements.
Participate in information system security inspections, assessments, tests, and reviews.
Maintains a working knowledge of system functions, security policies, technical security safeguards and operational security measures.
Schedules periodic testing and other continuous monitoring activities to evaluate the security posture of IS.
Develops an effective information system security education, training, and awareness program.
Interfaces with internal and external customers and auditors, program managers, IT, security staff, etc.
Support security incident response, investigations, and corrective actions.

Other Job Functions

Other duties as assigned

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:

Coordination of Information System Security Officers (ISSO) and System Administrators (SysAdmins)

Experience and Skills

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:

U.S. Citizenship required.
Must have active in-scope TOP SECRET clearance and be able to obtain and maintain access to Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and/or any necessary Special Access Programs (SAP).
DCSA eMASS experience required.
ATO accreditation.
Thorough understanding of US Government (DoD) IS security policies.
Strong communication skills, strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills; self-motivated with ability to effectively prioritize multiple projects; ability to work with people in a team environment and deal effectively with changing project priorities.
Ability to manage time, make sound decisions, take independent action, analyze problems and provide focused solutions.
High degree of attention to detail.
DoD 8140/DoD 8570 approved (IAM Level 2-3) certification required within 6 months of hire.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
System accreditation experience under DCSA cognizance utilizing eMASS .
5+ years of experience in Information Technology (IT) in a classified environment, or 3+ years of experience as an ISSM in Industrial security.
Strong understanding of identity and access management, endpoint security, network security, logging/monitoring, and incident response
Experience administering Windows and Linux operating systems, experience with large-scale server systems, thin client architecture, system virtualization and other related peripherals.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, RMF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, or equivalent.

WORK ENVIRONMENT/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This position involves work in an office and laboratory environment and could require the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) including:
Safety glasses
Hearing protection (varied based on tasks)
Shoe covers
Physical demands
Perform work using a computer for extended periods of time.
Sit or stand for extended periods of time without leaving the work area.
Climb ladders and stairs.
Walk for considerable distances.
Lift objects up to 50 pounds.
Reach for objects above head or below waist.
Stoop or crouch by bending at the waist or by bending legs.
Withstand exposure to low and high temperature levels that result in possible body discomfort.

COMPENSATION

Salary is based in experience and qualifications. Benefits include: company-sponsored health insurance, 401(k) and two (2) weeks PTO for full-time employees.

jobs.title: Senior Business and Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About Us

Abacus Insights is transforming how data and AI work for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.

As the AI and Data Platform for Payer Intelligence, we help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions—so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we're tackling big challenges in an industry that's ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it's why we are leading the way.

Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.

Ready to make an impact? Join us and let's build the future together.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Business and Data Analyst to join our team. In this role, you'll be the analytical engine between a client's business need and the data solution that delivers it. You'll turn business questions into precise, testable requirements, then use the data itself to prove out what's possible: profiling sources, validating assumptions, and shaping designs that are clean, buildable, and grounded in evidence rather than opinion. You'll own the requirements and analysis for your use cases and workstreams, working in close partnership with Business Solution Managers who hold the broader engagement.

Doing that well takes two things at once: command of healthcare business context, and deep, hands-on fluency in the data. This is a client-facing role. You'll translate complex healthcare challenges into rigorous requirements, and you'll use SQL and analytical judgment to show clients and delivery teams what the data actually says, where it falls short, and what that means for the design.

No engagement lives in isolation. A data model built for one client's use case can share structure with a completely different client's need; a transformation rule written for one state's requirements often anticipates the next state's. You'll learn to see each requirement as part of a larger system of clients, states, use cases, and data flows, and to flag where a design can be reused or where it could collide with other work.

Our clients are US health plans and the partners who serve them, and the engagements span everything it takes to make their data usable. That can mean standardizing and migrating data onto a new platform, meeting evolving regulatory and compliance mandates, or powering the broader analytics and reporting programs that drive payer performance across Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial lines of business.

Note: This role is based in the US and requires current authorization to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship.

Your day to day

Analyze the Data and Build the Evidence

Write and execute SQL daily to profile source data, test assumptions, quantify data quality (completeness, validity, uniqueness, consistency, timeliness), and prototype logic before it reaches the build team.
Analyze source data to establish what is actually available and reliable: field population and distributions, key integrity, duplicates, outliers, and gaps against what the business use case needs.
Reconcile and validate outputs against source systems and client-provided benchmarks (claim counts, member months, paid amounts, enrollment spans, provider rosters), investigating variances to root cause and documenting findings.
Define and document business metrics and KPIs precisely: numerator, denominator, inclusion and exclusion logic, time basis, and grain, so every consumer of the data calculates and reads them the same way.
Perform exploratory and root-cause analysis on client questions and data anomalies, and turn findings into clear, quantified recommendations for client and internal audiences.
Summarize findings through data profiling reports, analysis readouts, and visualizations that make the story clear to non-technical stakeholders.

Drive Requirements And Design For Your Use Cases

Lead discovery sessions for your use cases, and support broader engagement-level sessions alongside the Business Solution Manager, to understand the why and what behind each use case: the business context, pain points, expected outcomes, and success criteria, rather than just the surface-level data ask.
Translate each use case into clear, testable requirements, including success criteria and non-functional requirements, and maintain traceability from business need to requirement to design to test.
Use data analysis to sharpen and challenge requirements: confirm that what the client is asking for is supported by the data they have, and surface gaps early.
Document source-to-target mappings, transformation logic, and business rules that developers can build from, and define the test conditions and expected results QA will use to validate them.
Recommend the appropriate grain and structure of a dataset given the business context, and analyze how that grain decision ripples into the downstream reports, models, or programs that consume the data.
Identify dependencies before a design is finalized: which other workstreams, reports, or client use cases touch this same data, and how a change here could break or benefit them, escalating cross-workstream impacts to the Business Solution Manager.
Apply systems thinking: recognize when a design built for one client, state, or use case can become a reusable pattern, and raise and shape that reuse rather than discovering it in hindsight.

Be a Trusted Client-Facing Partner

Drive requirements-gathering and clarification conversations with client SMEs for your use cases, since incomplete or poorly elicited requirements undermine everything built downstream.
Present analysis results, data quality findings, and recommendations to client stakeholders with clarity and confidence, and guide decisions with evidence.
Represent client intent for your use cases through delivery and serve as a day-to-day point of contact, with the Business Solution Manager owning the overall client relationship.
Translate fluently between business and technical audiences, so both sides share the same understanding.

Collaborate Across Delivery

Connect the client and the internal team on your workstreams, holding the business context, data findings, and design drivers that shape the build.
Act as the business and data analysis SME for Solution Architects, Product, QA, Account Management, and Program Management, giving them clean hand-offs with the context, business rules, and analysis they need to execute without rework or reinterpretation.
Support QA and UAT by supplying validation queries, expected results, and variance analysis, and by helping triage defects to business rule, mapping, or source data causes.
Maintain awareness of the wider engagement: understand how a decision made for one workstream affects the others, and flag those ripple effects before they surface as rework.

What You Bring To The Team

Bachelor's degree, or equivalent relevant experience.
5+ years working in the US healthcare domain and with healthcare data (claims, provider, membership/eligibility, benefits, prior authorization, or PBM).
Payer experience required: direct experience working with or for a US health plan (Medicare, Medicaid, or Commercial), whether in-house or through healthcare consulting.
Working command of core payer concepts such as membership/enrollment, provider, claims, and authorizations, enough to reason about business context rather than specialize narrowly in any one area.
Strong, hands-on SQL: comfortable with joins across large, multi-table datasets, window functions, CTEs, aggregations, and date/span logic, used regularly to profile, validate, reconcile, and analyze data. Exposure to Databricks or Snowflake is desirable. This is distinct from a software or data engineering background.
Demonstrated analytical rigor: a track record of profiling data, assessing data quality, investigating anomalies to root cause, and communicating quantified findings that drove a decision.
Experience defining metrics, mentoring junior analysts, and eliciting and authoring business requirements in complex, data-driven environments.
Confident client-facing communication; able to drive a conversation, elicit requirements clearly, and present analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
Comfort operating with ambiguity and re-prioritizing frequently while managing multiple use cases within a larger engagement.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
At least 4 years of experience in purchasing operations, procurement operations, procure-to-pay, supply chain systems, or a related business operations role.

Experience partnering with IT and business functions to troubleshoot systems, document requirements, test changes, and support implementations or enhancements.
Experience with procurement controls, audit support, access governance, approval governance, or SOX-controlled business processes.
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Smartsheet and experience creating or maintaining operational reports and dashboards.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, customer-service orientation, and ability to manage multiple priorities independently.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced SAP Ariba administration experience, particularly within Buying and Invoicing, approval workflows, user administration, supplier enablement, and Ariba Business Network.
Experience with SAP S/4HANA and integrations between Ariba, SAP, invoice-management tools, identity or access systems, and enterprise data platforms.
Experience with Power BI, spend analytics, procurement performance metrics, or enterprise data reporting.
Experience developing user acceptance testing plans, test scripts, training materials, standard operating procedures, and work instructions.
Knowledge of source-to-pay processes, segregation-of-duties concepts, supplier master data, financial approval structures, and procurement policy enforcement.
Experience in a life sciences, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or other regulated environment.
SAP Ariba certification or relevant procurement, systems, analytics, or project-management certification.

Let people be their best
Respect one another and act as one

Know someone’s health is in our hands
Own the solution and make it happen

Who We Want

buildOn seeks an experienced, passionate, and mission-driven Program Manager
to manage and directly lead buildOn’s Service Learning Program at assigned partner high schools in Bridgeport, Connecticut. Reporting to the Executive Director of the region, the Program Manager will serve as the primary buildOn leader in Bridgeport, while coaching and supporting three Student Engagement Specialists who contribute to the delivery of buildOn programming. This is a hands-on, field-based leadership role that combines program management, staff supervision, school partnership development, and student engagement
. The Program Manager will ensure that buildOn’s service-learning program is implemented with quality and consistency while creating a strong culture of Constructive Leadership among students and staff.

This role combines direct student engagement in programming with supervision of multiple staff members. The ideal candidate is a strong relationship-builder, organized people manager, and committed youth development professional who can balance day-to-day program execution with staff development and long-term program growth. The Program Manager partners closely with Engagement Specialists, school administrators and faculty, and community partners to develop excellent service opportunities with buildOn students. Additionally, the Program Manager works closely with colleagues to plan and execute regional program events, and oversees and leads recruitment and support of students for Immersions (Trek, 36 Hours, and Partnership program) as well as special events. The Program Manager is expected to be highly visible and actively engaged at the assigned Bridgeport high schools, in the community, and alongside the Engagement Specialist team. The role requires strong organization, communication, relationship-building, follow-through, and the ability to balance people management with hands-on program leadership.

This is a great opportunity for a mission-driven leader who enjoys working with people and overseeing programs. If you have a history of leading successful teams with measurable results, then join buildOn as we continue to grow and change the world!

What You’ll Do

Lead a team of Student Engagement Specialists to engage students in buildOn’s service-learning program. This is not a remote position. Instead, it requires full-time activity in schools and in the community, coaching your team and serving alongside students and partners.

Team Leadership and Coaching of Engagement Specialists

Direct Management

Directly supervise three Student Engagement Specialists responsible for supporting buildOn programming at the partner high schools.
Provide clear expectations, priorities, and accountability for program delivery, student engagement, school relationships, data management, and service-learning planning.
Conduct regular one-on-one meetings and team check-ins to monitor progress, identify challenges, and support staff success.
Build realistic work plans and schedules that enable Engagement Specialists to effectively balance student engagement, school responsibilities, service planning, administrative tasks, and community partnerships.

Coaching, Development & Accountability

Serve as a coach, role model, and accountability partner for Engagement Specialists, helping them strengthen their professional and program-management skills.
Conduct regular observations of Engagement Specialists using buildOn’s program quality standards and provide specific, actionable feedback.
Model strong professional habits, including proactive communication, timely follow-through, thoughtful planning, effective school partnership management, and accurate data entry.
Identify performance gaps early, establish clear expectations for improvement, and provide appropriate coaching and support.
Invest in the professional development and long-term growth of Engagement Specialists.

Program Quality & Methodology

Monitor the quality of programming delivered by Engagement Specialists and ensure alignment with buildOn’s service-learning methodology and Constructive Leadership framework.
Use student engagement data, observations, and staff feedback to identify program strengths, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
Support Engagement Specialists in developing high-quality service-learning experiences that center student voice, leadership, reflection, and community impact.

Relationship Building, Data Management & Cross-departmental Collaboration

Relationship Building

Maintain relationships with school partners in your portfolio (teaching advisors, principals, and administration) to ensure strong partnerships.
Meet and communicate regularly with school partners to highlight the success of the program and also troubleshoot any issues that arise in a timely manner.
Work with the Program Director, the Community Partnerships team, and Student Engagement Specialists to cultivate partnerships with local community-based organizations to increase meaningful opportunities for students to serve.

Data & Reporting

Use Salesforce to accurately track student engagement, service hours, and program participation.
Review engagement data regularly to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for program improvement.
Ensure timely completion of monthly engagement logs, surveys, and other MERL reporting requirements.
Use data to support staff accountability and inform program planning.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration

Work across departments to support organizational goals as one buildOn, including:
Marketing:
Share student stories, service highlights, and program successes.
Events:
Support student recruitment and participation in buildOn events and special opportunities.
Development:
Provide program and community partnership information to support grants and reporting.

What You Bring

Personal commitment to buildOn's mission — the power of service to change lives, communities, and the world. A demonstrated commitment to service in your own life.
Extensive experience living and/or working in underserved communities.
Commitment to creating programs for youth that are empowering and antiracist.
Demonstrated ability to use student engagement data (Key Performance Indicators) to increase engagement.
Flexible and able to manage the ambiguity and multiple priorities inherent in an entrepreneurial environment.
3+ years engaging youth in service learning.
1+ years managing high-performing teams (preferred).
Experience mentoring and/coaching a team.
Invested in continual growth and learning through ongoing discovery, planning and execution, and reflection.
Strong communicator with a track record of mentoring and coaching others to achieve results.
Relevant educational background.

What We Offer

When you join us in this movement, you’ll enjoy a rewarding career that provides you with the benefits and flexibility you need; while ensuring that you have the opportunity to learn and grow through annual performance reviews, opportunities for advancement and professional development opportunities.

Our Benefits

Opportunity to connect and network with leaders of Fortune 500 organizations
A generous time off policy that includes paid vacation (10), personal and sick(12) days, along with a summer and end-of-year shutdown week (10 days).
100% insurance premium paid for medical, dental and vision along with subsidized deductibles.

jobs.title: Business Analyst Intégration (H/F)- Lausanne
jobs.description:
La data chez Synotis, ce n’est pas un buzzword : c’est une pratique rigoureuse. Nous bâtissons des architectures ouvertes, performantes, souveraines et durables, pensées pour fluidifier et fiabiliser les échanges applicatifs critiques. Des modèles de données jusqu'aux interfaces inter-systèmes, nous posons des fondations solides pour les acteurs majeurs de l'industrie, du luxe, de la banque et du secteur public en Suisse romande.

La mission

Au Cœur D'un Projet De Modernisation Du Paysage Applicatif Pour Une Manufacture De Prestige Située Dans La Région Romande, Vous Faites Le Pont Stratégique Entre Les Métiers, Les Équipes Applicatives (ERP, CRM, PLM, E-commerce) Et Les Équipes D'intégration Technique. Vous Transformez Les Besoins Métier En Spécifications D'interfaces Claires, Robustes Et Pérennes. Votre Rôle S’articule En Trois Temps

Cadrer et cartographier
Animer les ateliers d’alignement avec les référents métiers et les Business Analysts applicatifs pour capter les besoins d’échange de données.
Cartographier l'écosystème de flux (sources, cibles, criticité, protocoles, volumétries et propriété de la donnée).
Veiller à l'intégrité et à l'alignement des données de référence (MDM : référentiels clients, articles, partenaires, distribution) en lien avec la gouvernance Data.
Spécifier et sécuriser
Rédiger les dossiers de spécifications technico-fonctionnelles détaillées des flux et APIs (mappings champ à champ, règles de transformation, gestion des rejets et reprises sur erreur).
Collaborer avec les architectes d'intégration sur les patterns cibles : APIs synchrones, flux asynchrones / événementiels, batchs, échanges de fichiers sécurisés ou EDI.
Rédiger les critères d'acceptation, concevoir les jeux de tests et piloter la recette d'intégration de bout en bout.
Faciliter et moderniser
Assurer le suivi et la fluidité des développements avec les équipes techniques en méthodologie Agile / Scrum.
Structurer la documentation des flux et préparer le passage de relais vers les équipes d'exploitation (MCO).
Utiliser les outils d'IA appliquée pour accélérer l'analyse, l'ingénierie de spécification et la génération de scénarios de test.

L'écosystème technique

Flux & Protocoles : APIs REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, CSV, formats EDI, flux asynchrones et événementiels (Kafka ou équivalent).
Plateformes & Middleware : Compréhension d'un ESB d'entreprise (notamment Talend ESB / DI, Apache Camel) et principes d'urbanisation de flux.
Modélisation & Analyse : BPMN, diagrammes de séquence, modèles conceptuels et logiques de données, SQL.
Écosystème Applicatif : Environnement ERP (idéalement SAP ECC ou S/4HANA) interconnecté à des outils spécialisés (CRM, PLM, MES, e-commerce).
Outillage & Qualité : Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, Jira, Confluence, Xray, outils d'IA générative.

Votre profil

Titulaire D’une Formation Supérieure En Informatique De Gestion, Systèmes D'information Ou Diplôme D'ingénieur (HES, EPFL, Université), Vous Justifiez D’au Moins 5 Ans D'expérience En Business Analysis, Dont 3 Ans Minimum Dédiés à Des Projets D'intégration Ou D'interfaçage Applicatif. On Parie Que Vous Cochez Aussi Ces Cases

Une solide pratique des projets d'intégration autour d'un ERP (SAP idéalement) et d'applications satellites.
Une excellente maîtrise de la modélisation de flux (BPMN), du SQL et de la formalisation de contrats d'interfaces (APIs, mapping).
Une expérience acquise dans un environnement exigeant (industrie, luxe, retail ou horlogerie).
Une grande aisance relationnelle pour animer des ateliers, vulgariser les contraintes techniques auprès du métier et challenger les choix fonctionnels.
Français courant obligatoire, avec un anglais professionnel opérationnel (niveau B2 minimum, C1 apprécié).

Pourquoi Synotis ?

Projets d'envergure : Vous intervenez au cœur de la transformation du SI d'une maison de référence, sur des flux à haute valeur ajoutée.
Équilibre & Cadre : Rythme de travail flexible avec télétravail partiel accordé.
Évolution continue : Parcours de formation sur-mesure, certifications reconnues (IIBA, Scrum, plateformes d'intégration) et veille technologique active (IA, gouvernance Data).
Synergie de groupe : L'esprit convivial d'une structure romande à taille humaine adossée à l'expertise technologique européenne du groupe Smile.

Les prochaines étapes

Premier contact : Échange téléphonique de découverte pour cerner vos aspirations et répondre à vos questions.
Entretien métier / méthodologique : Discussion autour de vos réalisations passées et cas pratiques de modélisation de flux.
Échange Direction : Rencontre dédiée à notre vision, vos perspectives d'évolution et nos valeurs d'équipe.

jobs.title: Senior Cryogenic Business Development & Program Manager
jobs.description:
PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.

That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum's most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas Zennström.

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have the funding, the government validation, and the sites under construction to make it real.

Job Summary

PsiQuantum's Photonics & Technologies group turns the company's core platforms into commercial products. The Cryogenic Interconnect business line brings our data-center-grade cryogenics to AI rack-scale interconnect.

Turns PsiQuantum's cryogenic capabilities into customer programs — and delivers them.
PsiQuantum is the only company bringing data-center-grade cryogenics to AI infrastructure. This role works directly with customers to find where cryogenic operation solves their problems in interconnect reach, cooling density and next-generation architecture; shapes those opportunities into programs; and then manages those programs from first hardware through qualification into production.

Responsibilities

Identify and develop opportunities where PsiQuantum's cryogenic capabilities — data-center-grade cryostats, thermal containment, warm-to-cold interfaces — solve AI data center problems, across interconnect, cooling and future rack architectures.
Convert opportunities into programs: scope, phase structure, statements of work, acceptance criteria and pricing.
Manage those programs end to end with customer and internal teams.
Coordinate joint demonstrations and qualification gates across internal engineering, customer deliverables and external suppliers.

Experience/Qualifications

10+ years spanning business development and program management for datacenter, networking or complex hardware systems, with 3+ years running customer-funded co-development or NPI programs through qualification into production.
Commercial fluency in co-development structures: SOWs, phased POs, acceptance gates, production frameworks, take-or-pay and capacity reservation terms.
Technically credible: can hold a room on thermal budgets, qualification criteria and schedule risk without an interpreter.
Experience coordinating across a customer, contract fabricators and long-lead suppliers simultaneously.
Comfort developing programs for a product that is still being defined, where the specification and the schedule move together.

The Wireless IST team is seeking a proactive Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead complex, cross-functional hardware programs from concept through customer delivery in a fast-moving environment with high customer expectations. You will own the end-to-end Keysight program for a leading global technology customer whose priorities can evolve quickly and who expects speed, adaptability, and clear communication from its partners.

You will lead through engineering managers and program managers across functions and work directly with the customer to drive schedules, risks, communication, and alignment across R&D, IST, manufacturing, supply chain, support, and customer teams. Job Description

Trucordia is seeking a Technical Program Manager to lead delivery for our Data & Analytics team. You'll own how work moves from business request to production: intake, prioritization, requirements, sprint execution, release, and adoption. You'll serve as the bridge between stakeholders in Finance, Accounting, Operations, Benefits, and the field, and the engineers and analysts who build our reports, integrations, automations, and data pipelines.

This role combines Agile delivery leadership, business analysis, and technical coordination. You'll be expected to understand the data work well enough to challenge estimates, spot dependency risks, and translate between technical and business audiences. You'll also use AI and automation to handle routine overhead like status reports, documentation drafts, and ticket hygiene, so your time goes to prioritization, stakeholder alignment, and risk management.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Program & Agile Delivery

Own end-to-end delivery across concurrent Data & Analytics initiatives, including program planning, sprint planning, standups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
Manage the intake-to-delivery workflow and program roadmap, keeping the backlog prioritized, groomed, and build-ready.
Track dependencies, risks, blockers, team capacity, and delivery metrics (velocity, cycle time, throughput, predictability), and act on what the data shows.
Maintain a program-level RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies), escalate appropriately, and drive mitigation plans.
Continuously improve team processes, ceremonies, and workflows.

Business Analysis & Requirements

Partner with business stakeholders to gather, document, and validate requirements.
Translate business needs into epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, and implementation plans, owning the accuracy of the final output.
Analyze current-state processes, identify improvement opportunities, and assess the downstream impact of changes to systems, data sources, and workflows.
Support evaluation of tools, technologies, and solution approaches through research and recommendations.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and the Data & Analytics team, aligning on priorities, timelines, and trade-offs.
Facilitate cross-functional and executive-level meetings and communicate program health clearly and consistently.
Coordinate releases, training, and change management so delivered solutions are adopted.
Provide regular reporting to leadership on progress, risks, and outcomes, using automated dashboards and reporting where possible.

Data Onboarding, Quality, & Documentation

Manage agency onboarding, data ingestion, and data migration as program workstreams, including milestones, dependencies, cutover planning, and data readiness.
Coordinate user acceptance testing and validate delivered work against requirements and data quality standards.
Maintain documentation, playbooks, runbooks, and knowledge-base content in Confluence or similar, keeping materials accurate and current.

Qualifications

5+ years of experience in technical program management, project management, Agile delivery, Scrum Master, or business analysis roles, including at least 3 years owning delivery for data, analytics, BI, or technical teams.
Proven ownership of backlogs, delivery processes, and execution across multiple concurrent initiatives.
Strong requirements-gathering skills, with a track record of turning ambiguous requests into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans.
Working technical knowledge of data concepts: data pipelines and ETL/ELT, data validation and quality checks, file formats (CSV, JSON, flat files), APIs and integrations, and basic data modeling.
Ability to write and read basic-to-intermediate SQL for validating data and answering delivery questions.
Advanced Excel skills (lookups, pivot tables, data reconciliation).
Hands-on experience managing work in Jira or Azure DevOps, including boards, workflows, filters, and dashboards.
Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to accelerate documentation, requirements, or reporting, with sound judgment about when to verify AI output.
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, including influencing engineers and leadership without direct authority.
Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Certifications such as PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, PSM, or SAFe.
Experience in insurance, insurance brokerage, or financial services, particularly with agency acquisitions or integrations.
Familiarity with agency management systems (e.g., Applied Epic, Vertafore AMS360).
Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse, and BI platforms such as Power BI or Tableau.
Experience with Confluence, Monday.com, Smartsheet, or similar collaboration and planning tools.
Experience supporting data migrations, UAT, data quality initiatives, or reporting automation.
Experience building AI-powered workflows or automations (e.g., Power Automate, Zapier, Jira automation) to reduce manual PM work.

What Success Looks like in Year One:

A predictable, program-level delivery process running across all Data & Analytics initiatives.
A healthy backlog with at least two sprints of build-ready work.
A reliable, documented intake-to-delivery workflow that stakeholders understand and use.

Hybrid

Bensalem, PA

We live sneakers, streetwear, and neighborhood culture! All Day! Every Day!

With more than 750 stores in Europe and the USA, SNIPES is one of the leading sneaker and streetwear retailers worldwide. Since opening its first store in Essen, Germany in 1998, SNIPES has been an integral part of street culture and is constantly growing thanks to its proximity to the community and regular openings worldwide.

At SNIPES, everything revolves around youth culture. In stores and online at snipes.com and snipesusa.com, our community finds a wide range of internationally renowned sneakers and apparel brands for the latest fits from head to toe. We dive deep into subcultures, sponsor some of the biggest hip-hop festivals, events, and sports teams throughout the world to stay close to our community and keep our deep roots in the global street culture community. Therefore, we work closely with key figures from the scene like DJ Khaled, our Chief Creative Officer. But whether it’s sponsorships or developing grassroots projects – we prioritize giving back to the community in everything we do.

SNIPES has always kept an ear to the streets to create a meaningful impact in the communities we serve. Through our community program “SNIPES serves” and its localized approach we support the needs of our communities, empower, and celebrate our dynamic culture.

Overview

Reporting to the Sr. Director of Real Estate and Construction, the Special Projects Manager of Store Development will oversee a diverse portfolio of projects across our retail store network, including new store builds, remodels, refreshes, fixture and equipment installations, brand initiatives, operational improvements, and other store development projects.
A critical responsibility of this role will be coordinating Tenant-Supplied Materials (TSM), including developing comprehensive material take-off documentation and delivery schedules to support accurate procurement, timely jobsite delivery, and successful project execution.

Responsibilities

Project Management & Delivery

Manage a portfolio of projects across new and existing stores, including new store construction, remodels, refreshes, relocations, fixture replacements, equipment installations, and operational improvements.
Lead projects from initial intake and feasibility assessment through scope development, budgeting, procurement, scheduling, execution, turnover, and final closeout.
Establish project objectives, milestones, deliverables, responsibilities, and success criteria to ensure alignment with business priorities.
Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, resource plans, and execution strategies while proactively identifying risks and addressing potential delays.
Manage multiple projects simultaneously, balancing competing priorities, deadlines, and business requirements.

Tenant-Supplied Materials & Procurement Coordination

Develop and maintain comprehensive Tenant-Supplied Materials (TSM) Take-Off Form
for each assigned project, identifying all materials, fixtures, equipment, and other items to be supplied by the company.
Coordinate with Construction, Design, Planning, Procurement, Store Operations, and other stakeholders to ensure all tenant-supplied materials are identified, accurately quantified, and documented before procurement deadlines.
Coordinate with Procurement to ensure complete and accurate project information is provided for purchasing, sourcing, vendor coordination, and delivery planning.
Monitor procurement progress and material delivery schedules to ensure all required items arrive at the appropriate location before installation or construction milestones.
Identify and resolve discrepancies in quantities, specifications, orders, shipping, and delivery dates before they impact project execution.
Maintain updated TSM documentation and communicate material status, outstanding items, and schedule risks to the project team.
Establish a consistent process for material take-offs, procurement handoffs, delivery tracking, and project-specific documentation.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Serve as the central project lead for special projects introduced into new and existing stores.
Coordinate project requirements, approvals, responsibilities, dependencies, and execution plans across Real Estate, Construction, Store Operations, Design, Visual Merchandising, IT, Asset Protection, Procurement, Finance, Marketing, and other business partners.
Facilitate project meetings, communicate action items, track outstanding decisions, and ensure stakeholders remain aligned throughout project execution.
Identify project conflicts, clarify ownership, and escalate issues requiring leadership decisions.

New Store Construction & Development

Manage assigned new store construction and build-out projects in coordination with Real Estate, Construction, landlords, architects, engineers, general contractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
Coordinate project requirements, design approvals, permitting, procurement, construction activities, inspections, and operational readiness.
Monitor construction progress and identify potential delays, cost impacts, or issues affecting scheduled store openings.
Ensure project execution aligns with approved plans, company standards, lease requirements, and operational expectations.
Support store opening readiness by coordinating outstanding construction items, material deliveries, installations, inspections, and turnover requirements.

Budget, Schedule & Risk Management

Develop and maintain project budgets, schedules, scopes of work, and resource requirements.
Track project expenditures, commitments, forecasts, change orders, and budget variances.
Evaluate proposed changes and communicate their impact on project costs, schedules, scope, and operational requirements.
Identify project risks, develop mitigation strategies, and implement corrective actions when performance deviates from established plans.
Provide timely escalation of schedule delays, budget concerns, procurement issues, and other risks requiring management attention.
Maintain accountability for delivering projects within approved budgets and established timelines.

Store Operations & Field Execution

Develop execution plans that minimize disruption to store operations, customer experience, and sales activities.
Coordinate site access, construction phasing, shutdowns, temporary conditions, installation schedules, and operational communications.
Manage contractors, installers, suppliers, and service providers to ensure work is completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with approved project requirements.
Conduct site visits to verify progress, evaluate field conditions, identify deficiencies, and resolve construction or installation issues.
Coordinate fixture installations, equipment upgrades, technology integrations, merchandising impacts, and other project activities with store teams.
Support store teams through project turnover, training coordination, operational readiness, and post-installation follow-up.

Quality, Compliance & Project Reporting

Ensure projects comply with company standards, approved plans and specifications, applicable building codes, accessibility requirements, life safety regulations, permitting requirements, and safety standards.
Monitor project quality and verify that completed work meets established requirements.
Maintain accurate project documentation, including scopes, budgets, schedules, approvals, procurement records, change orders, meeting notes, and closeout documentation.
Provide regular project status reports covering schedule, budget, procurement, material deliveries, risks, outstanding issues, and overall project performance.
Develop and maintain project tracking tools, dashboards, and reporting processes to improve visibility, accountability, and execution.
Conduct project closeout reviews, document lessons learned, and identify opportunities to improve future project delivery.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, Business, or a related field preferred.
Minimum of 5 years of project management or construction management experience in multi-site retail, commercial construction, store development, facilities, or a related environment.
