new_jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced PAM Project Manager to lead the planning, governance, and delivery of enterprise Privileged Access Management initiatives. The role requires strong project-management capability combined with a working understanding of PAM technologies, operating models, security controls, and implementation dependencies.
The PAM Project Manager will be responsible for managing project scope, schedules, budgets, risks, dependencies, resources, and stakeholder communications across PAM implementations, upgrades, integrations, privileged account onboarding, and service-transition activities. The role will coordinate closely with PAM Engineering, PAM Operations, application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure successful delivery.
The successful candidate will provide clear governance, maintain delivery discipline, proactively resolve impediments, and ensure that PAM initiatives are completed in accordance with agreed requirements, security standards, and organizational change-management processes.
Key Responsibilities
Project Planning & Delivery

Develop and maintain detailed project plans covering scope, milestones, deliverables, resource requirements, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
Lead end-to-end delivery of PAM initiatives, including new platform implementations, upgrades, migrations, integrations, and privileged account onboarding programs.
Track project progress against approved schedules and budgets, and implement recovery plans when delivery is at risk.
Coordinate activities across PAM Engineering, Operations, application, infrastructure, network, database, security, and vendor teams.
Ensure deliverables are reviewed, approved, and completed in accordance with established quality and security requirements.

Governance & Reporting

Establish and manage project governance, including status meetings, steering committee updates, decision logs, action registers, and stage-gate reviews.
Prepare accurate weekly and monthly status reports covering accomplishments, upcoming activities, schedule health, risks, issues, dependencies, and required decisions.
Maintain project documentation and ensure appropriate evidence is available for audits, control reviews, and project closure.
Monitor project financials, resource utilization, vendor deliverables, and contractual commitments.

Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

Identify, assess, document, and actively manage project risks, issues, assumptions, constraints, and cross-team dependencies.
Drive timely resolution of delivery blockers and escalate critical risks or decisions through the appropriate governance forums.
Manage scope changes through formal impact assessment, estimation, approval, and Change Request processes.
Ensure security, compliance, operational-readiness, and business-continuity requirements are incorporated into project plans.

PAM Implementation Coordination

Coordinate PAM discovery, requirements gathering, design reviews, build, testing, deployment, and hypercare activities.
Manage application and target-system onboarding waves, including readiness assessments, owner coordination, credential discovery, testing, cutover, and operational handover.
Coordinate integrations with enterprise directories, identity governance platforms, IT service-management tools, servers, databases, network devices, cloud platforms, and applications.
Track remediation of technical and operational gaps identified during testing, security reviews, or production readiness assessments.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

Serve as the primary project-management contact for business stakeholders, technology teams, security leadership, and third-party vendors.
Facilitate workshops, planning sessions, design reviews, and delivery checkpoints to align stakeholders and secure timely decisions.
Manage stakeholder expectations through transparent communication of scope, priorities, risks, and delivery status.
Coordinate vendor resources and verify that vendor deliverables meet contractual, technical, and quality expectations.

Testing, Transition & Closure

Coordinate system integration testing, user acceptance testing, security validation, defect management, and production-readiness reviews.
Develop and manage implementation, cutover, rollback, communications, training, and hypercare plans.
Ensure complete transition to PAM Operations, including approved runbooks, support procedures, knowledge transfer, monitoring, and support acceptance.
Conduct project closure activities, document lessons learned, and confirm completion of agreed outcomes and residual actions.

Qualifications
8 to 12 years of overall IT project-management experience, including at least 3 years managing cybersecurity, Identity and Access Management, or Privileged Access Management initiatives.
Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise PAM projects involving platforms such as Delinea Secret Server, CyberArk Privilege Cloud or PAM Self-Hosted, BeyondTrust Password Safe, or comparable technologies.
Strong understanding of PAM concepts, including credential vaulting, password rotation, session management, least privilege, service accounts, privileged access workflows, and account onboarding.
Experience managing application and target-system onboarding, platform upgrades, migrations, integrations, and operational-transition activities.
Working knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, servers, databases, network devices, cloud platforms, APIs, ITSM processes, and enterprise security controls.
Proficiency with project-management tools and methods, including Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps or Jira, RAID management, dependency tracking, financial reporting, and executive status reporting.
Strong stakeholder-management, facilitation, negotiation, problem-solving, and written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple workstreams and geographically distributed delivery teams in a matrix organization.
Project Management Professional (PMP), PRINCE2, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent certification is preferred.
Experience working in regulated environments and familiarity with controls such as NIST SP 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001, SOX, PCI DSS, or similar frameworks is preferred.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager – Security Systems Integration
new_jobs.description:
Project Manager – Security Systems Integration
Port Coquitlam, BC · Full-time · $95,000–$120,000 per year · Some Travel across Canada

About us We're an award-winning Canadian integrator that specializes in security systems. We take on work few companies can, combining different systems with off-the-shelf technology, custom electronics and prototyping, software and web technologies. Our clients are across Canada, on sites from the oceanside to deep mines, and from corporate offices to casinos.
Why this role, and why now We've grown because talented people find a way to get things done. Now we're building the structure to go with that talent: a clear, repeatable path for every project from Sales → Project Management Office(PMO) → Design → Execution
, with defined ownership at each step.
We're hiring a Project Manager to help run that system and make it stick. You won't be the hero who rescues a project at the last minute. You'll be the person who makes those rescues unnecessary.
This could be the job for you if you value predictable delivery, clean handoffs and decisions written down, and you can keep a team moving while you introduce new ways of working.
What you'll own Project activation and handoffs

•    Bring new projects in through a formal activation process, and confirm the Sales handoff package is complete before work starts
•    Accept or return incomplete deliverables at each stage, and meet the same standard for what you hand to Design and Delivery
•    Make sure everyone understands the documented scope, schedule, budget and risks before execution begins
Scope and change control

•    Own project scope. Every change, including changes involving other trades, goes through a formal change order instead of being absorbed quietly
•    Work with Sales on the commercial impact of changes, and with Design on the technical impact
Planning, cost and schedule

•    Build and manage detailed schedules, work plans and budgets from the scope and the resources it needs
•    Track costs and progress against estimates, and raise variances early
•    Commit to completion dates you can keep, then protect them
Capacity and portfolio visibility

•    Run several large projects at once, and keep capacity, schedule and portfolio health visible at the PMO level
•    Contribute to the annual schedule and resource forecast
Quality and risk

•    Identify and track technical, compliance, financial and reputational risk, and escalate through defined paths
•    Log, report and resolve non-conformances (NCRs) accurately, including supplier-related issues
•    Cut down on return visits after a project is "done"
Communication and people

•    Give stakeholders regular, honest updates that cover what's going well as well as what isn't
•    Manage vendors and suppliers with clear tasks and expected deliverables
•    Work with Technical Project Supervisors to support technicians' career development and continuing education
•    Help define, measure and improve the KPIs we deliver against
Where you fit •     Sales
owns the client relationship and the commercial agreement
•     PMO (you)
owns scope, schedule, cost, change control and portfolio visibility
•     Technical Design
owns the solution design
•     Technical Project Supervisors
own site execution and direct the technicians
•     Technical Delivery Teams
build and commission the systems
You won't design systems or work on site with tools. You will need to understand the technology well enough to ask the right questions, spot risk early and judge whether a deliverable is really ready.
What success looks like In your first year you'll help us:
•    Run every new project through formal activation
•    Cut the number of completion-date changes
•    Reduce design changes found on site
•    Reduce escalations and emergency firefighting
•    Win more repeat work from existing clients
•    Run more projects at the same time without burning people out
You'll also help pilot this new delivery model before it rolls out across the company.
What you bring Required

•    Proven experience running several large projects at the same time with established project management practices, ideally in security, low-voltage, electrical or systems integration
•    A track record of formal change-order management, including coordination with other trades
•    Experience with project budgeting, scheduling and cost tracking
•    Working knowledge of networking, access control and video surveillance, enough to read drawings and assess technical risk
•    Security TQ
•    Clear, professional spoken and written English
Assets

•    PMP, CAPM or a similar designation, or formal project management education
•    FSR certification
•    Experience with stage gates, handoff standards or quality systems (for example ISO 9001)
•    Experience with NCR and corrective-action processes, and with KPI reporting
•    Ability to read and mark up AutoCAD drawings
•    Bilingual (English/French)
People who do well here

•    Would rather fix the process than fix the same problem twice
•    Stay calm and communicate steadily under pressure
•    Hold the line on scope, respectfully, with clients and with colleagues
•    Earn credibility with technicians and executives alike
What we offer •    Competitive salary ($95,000–$120,000, based on experience) and company health benefits
•    Company vehicle, cell phone and laptop
•    Paid training, certification and continuing education
•    A real say in how a growing company delivers its projects, and a career path that grows with it
Our standards Safety comes first, always. We expect respect, honesty, accountability, confidentiality and professional conduct from everyone, everywhere.
We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants regardless of gender, race or religion. Accommodations are available on request throughout the hiring process.
Conditions of employment •    Ability to pass multiple security background checks (local, provincial and federal)
•    Ability to pass pre-employment and annual drug and alcohol testing
•    Willingness to travel, sometimes on short notice
•    Professional communication, appearance and demeanour. Your calm confidence and knowledge should reassure clients
How to apply Send your resume and cover letter, both in PDF, to careers@unifiedsystems.ca .
In your cover letter, tell us about a time you brought structure to a project or a team that didn't have it, and what changed as a result.

new_jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY:

NineTwelve is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) to lead security management and compliance activities for information systems for a highly technical facility supporting Department of War operations. The ISSM will be responsible for ensuring systems are securely designed, implemented, operated, and maintained in accordance with organizational security policies, regulatory requirements, and applicable cybersecurity frameworks. Candidates must have an active Top Secret clearance . This position is on-site and is neither hybrid nor remote eligible.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

Implement the risk management framework for classified systems, typically following the Defense Counterintelligence Security Agency (DCSA), DAAG, or JSIG process and supporting communications with cognizant security authorities.
Serve as the primary point of contact for classified systems.
Produce and maintain Body of Evidence (BoE) documentation to include risk assessments, System Security Plan (SSP’s) and Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M’s).
Maintain the day-to-day security posture and continuous monitoring for all systems, including patching and updates.
Assist Information Security team in unclassified security operations, including continuous monitoring, incident response, and vulnerability management.
Assist Information Technology team in unclassified services functions.
Ensure all users have the requisite security clearances, authorization, need-to-know, and are aware of their security responsibilities before granting access to the information systems.
Ensures adherence to information system security policies and procedures.
Coordinate vulnerability management, security assessments, penetration testing, and remediation activities.
Performs oversight and provides guidance for media sanitization and destruction.
Confirms domain/local policies are configured to meet regulatory requirements.
Assesses changes to the system/operational needs that could affect its accreditation.
Voting/veto member of the CCB for all systems.
Assists with coordination between Kratos and Government authorities regarding system security posture requirements.
Participate in information system security inspections, assessments, tests, and reviews.
Maintains a working knowledge of system functions, security policies, technical security safeguards and operational security measures.
Schedules periodic testing and other continuous monitoring activities to evaluate the security posture of IS.
Develops an effective information system security education, training, and awareness program.
Interfaces with internal and external customers and auditors, program managers, IT, security staff, etc.
Support security incident response, investigations, and corrective actions.

Other Job Functions

Other duties as assigned

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:

Coordination of Information System Security Officers (ISSO) and System Administrators (SysAdmins)

Experience and Skills

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:

U.S. Citizenship required.
Must have active in-scope TOP SECRET clearance and be able to obtain and maintain access to Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and/or any necessary Special Access Programs (SAP).
DCSA eMASS experience required.
ATO accreditation.
Thorough understanding of US Government (DoD) IS security policies.
Strong communication skills, strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills; self-motivated with ability to effectively prioritize multiple projects; ability to work with people in a team environment and deal effectively with changing project priorities.
Ability to manage time, make sound decisions, take independent action, analyze problems and provide focused solutions.
High degree of attention to detail.
DoD 8140/DoD 8570 approved (IAM Level 2-3) certification required within 6 months of hire.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
System accreditation experience under DCSA cognizance utilizing eMASS .
5+ years of experience in Information Technology (IT) in a classified environment, or 3+ years of experience as an ISSM in Industrial security.
Strong understanding of identity and access management, endpoint security, network security, logging/monitoring, and incident response
Experience administering Windows and Linux operating systems, experience with large-scale server systems, thin client architecture, system virtualization and other related peripherals.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, RMF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, or equivalent.

WORK ENVIRONMENT/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This position involves work in an office and laboratory environment and could require the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) including:
Safety glasses
Hearing protection (varied based on tasks)
Shoe covers
Physical demands
Perform work using a computer for extended periods of time.
Sit or stand for extended periods of time without leaving the work area.
Climb ladders and stairs.
Walk for considerable distances.
Lift objects up to 50 pounds.
Reach for objects above head or below waist.
Stoop or crouch by bending at the waist or by bending legs.
Withstand exposure to low and high temperature levels that result in possible body discomfort.

COMPENSATION

new_jobs.title: Senior Business and Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
About Us

Abacus Insights is transforming how data and AI work for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.

As the AI and Data Platform for Payer Intelligence, we help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions—so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we're tackling big challenges in an industry that's ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it's why we are leading the way.

Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.

Ready to make an impact? Join us and let's build the future together.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Business and Data Analyst to join our team. In this role, you'll be the analytical engine between a client's business need and the data solution that delivers it. You'll turn business questions into precise, testable requirements, then use the data itself to prove out what's possible: profiling sources, validating assumptions, and shaping designs that are clean, buildable, and grounded in evidence rather than opinion. You'll own the requirements and analysis for your use cases and workstreams, working in close partnership with Business Solution Managers who hold the broader engagement.

Doing that well takes two things at once: command of healthcare business context, and deep, hands-on fluency in the data. This is a client-facing role. You'll translate complex healthcare challenges into rigorous requirements, and you'll use SQL and analytical judgment to show clients and delivery teams what the data actually says, where it falls short, and what that means for the design.

No engagement lives in isolation. A data model built for one client's use case can share structure with a completely different client's need; a transformation rule written for one state's requirements often anticipates the next state's. You'll learn to see each requirement as part of a larger system of clients, states, use cases, and data flows, and to flag where a design can be reused or where it could collide with other work.

Our clients are US health plans and the partners who serve them, and the engagements span everything it takes to make their data usable. That can mean standardizing and migrating data onto a new platform, meeting evolving regulatory and compliance mandates, or powering the broader analytics and reporting programs that drive payer performance across Medicare, Medicaid, and Commercial lines of business.

Note: This role is based in the US and requires current authorization to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship.

Your day to day

Analyze the Data and Build the Evidence

Write and execute SQL daily to profile source data, test assumptions, quantify data quality (completeness, validity, uniqueness, consistency, timeliness), and prototype logic before it reaches the build team.
Analyze source data to establish what is actually available and reliable: field population and distributions, key integrity, duplicates, outliers, and gaps against what the business use case needs.
Reconcile and validate outputs against source systems and client-provided benchmarks (claim counts, member months, paid amounts, enrollment spans, provider rosters), investigating variances to root cause and documenting findings.
Define and document business metrics and KPIs precisely: numerator, denominator, inclusion and exclusion logic, time basis, and grain, so every consumer of the data calculates and reads them the same way.
Perform exploratory and root-cause analysis on client questions and data anomalies, and turn findings into clear, quantified recommendations for client and internal audiences.
Summarize findings through data profiling reports, analysis readouts, and visualizations that make the story clear to non-technical stakeholders.

Drive Requirements And Design For Your Use Cases

Lead discovery sessions for your use cases, and support broader engagement-level sessions alongside the Business Solution Manager, to understand the why and what behind each use case: the business context, pain points, expected outcomes, and success criteria, rather than just the surface-level data ask.
Translate each use case into clear, testable requirements, including success criteria and non-functional requirements, and maintain traceability from business need to requirement to design to test.
Use data analysis to sharpen and challenge requirements: confirm that what the client is asking for is supported by the data they have, and surface gaps early.
Document source-to-target mappings, transformation logic, and business rules that developers can build from, and define the test conditions and expected results QA will use to validate them.
Recommend the appropriate grain and structure of a dataset given the business context, and analyze how that grain decision ripples into the downstream reports, models, or programs that consume the data.
Identify dependencies before a design is finalized: which other workstreams, reports, or client use cases touch this same data, and how a change here could break or benefit them, escalating cross-workstream impacts to the Business Solution Manager.
Apply systems thinking: recognize when a design built for one client, state, or use case can become a reusable pattern, and raise and shape that reuse rather than discovering it in hindsight.

Be a Trusted Client-Facing Partner

Drive requirements-gathering and clarification conversations with client SMEs for your use cases, since incomplete or poorly elicited requirements undermine everything built downstream.
Present analysis results, data quality findings, and recommendations to client stakeholders with clarity and confidence, and guide decisions with evidence.
Represent client intent for your use cases through delivery and serve as a day-to-day point of contact, with the Business Solution Manager owning the overall client relationship.
Translate fluently between business and technical audiences, so both sides share the same understanding.

Collaborate Across Delivery

Connect the client and the internal team on your workstreams, holding the business context, data findings, and design drivers that shape the build.
Act as the business and data analysis SME for Solution Architects, Product, QA, Account Management, and Program Management, giving them clean hand-offs with the context, business rules, and analysis they need to execute without rework or reinterpretation.
Support QA and UAT by supplying validation queries, expected results, and variance analysis, and by helping triage defects to business rule, mapping, or source data causes.
Maintain awareness of the wider engagement: understand how a decision made for one workstream affects the others, and flag those ripple effects before they surface as rework.

What You Bring To The Team

Bachelor's degree, or equivalent relevant experience.
5+ years working in the US healthcare domain and with healthcare data (claims, provider, membership/eligibility, benefits, prior authorization, or PBM).
Payer experience required: direct experience working with or for a US health plan (Medicare, Medicaid, or Commercial), whether in-house or through healthcare consulting.
Working command of core payer concepts such as membership/enrollment, provider, claims, and authorizations, enough to reason about business context rather than specialize narrowly in any one area.
Strong, hands-on SQL: comfortable with joins across large, multi-table datasets, window functions, CTEs, aggregations, and date/span logic, used regularly to profile, validate, reconcile, and analyze data. Exposure to Databricks or Snowflake is desirable. This is distinct from a software or data engineering background.
Demonstrated analytical rigor: a track record of profiling data, assessing data quality, investigating anomalies to root cause, and communicating quantified findings that drove a decision.
Experience defining metrics, mentoring junior analysts, and eliciting and authoring business requirements in complex, data-driven environments.
Confident client-facing communication; able to drive a conversation, elicit requirements clearly, and present analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
Comfort operating with ambiguity and re-prioritizing frequently while managing multiple use cases within a larger engagement.
Developing systems thinking: experience designing for reuse and scale across states, clients, or use cases rather than solving each case in isolation, and the ability to trace how a requirement or data model decision affects other parts of a larger data ecosystem.

What We Would Like To See, But Not Required

Background that already blends business analysis with hands-on data work, such as a Business Analyst, Data Analyst, or Business Data Analyst role, with exposure to client-facing delivery.
Experience with BI and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or similar) to communicate analysis.
Familiarity with HEDIS and Stars quality reporting, risk adjustment, payment integrity, value-based care analytics, provider data management, or CMS interoperability (CMS-0057).
Working knowledge of data modeling concepts, including how the grain and structure of a dataset shape its downstream use.
Familiarity with Python or similar for analysis and automation.
Familiarity with Medicaid data or PBM platforms

Compensation

Compensation for this role is based on experience, skills, and location, and includes base salary plus eligibility for performance bonuses and equity grants.

What You’ll Get In Return

Unlimited paid time off – recharge when you need it
Work from anywhere – flexibility to fit your life
Comprehensive health coverage – multiple plan options to choose from
Equity for every employee – share in our success
Growth-focused environment – your development matters here
Home office setup allowance – one-time support to get you started
Monthly cell phone allowance – stay connected with ease

Our Commitment as an Equal Opportunity Employer

As a mission-led technology company helping to drive better healthcare outcomes, Abacus Insights believes that the best innovation and value we can bring to our customers comes from diverse ideas, thoughts, experiences, and perspectives. Therefore, we dedicate resources to building diverse teams and providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants. buildOn seeks an experienced, passionate, and mission-driven Program Manager
to manage and directly lead buildOn’s Service Learning Program at assigned partner high schools in Bridgeport, Connecticut. Reporting to the Executive Director of the region, the Program Manager will serve as the primary buildOn leader in Bridgeport, while coaching and supporting three Student Engagement Specialists who contribute to the delivery of buildOn programming. This is a hands-on, field-based leadership role that combines program management, staff supervision, school partnership development, and student engagement
. The Program Manager will ensure that buildOn’s service-learning program is implemented with quality and consistency while creating a strong culture of Constructive Leadership among students and staff.

This role combines direct student engagement in programming with supervision of multiple staff members. The ideal candidate is a strong relationship-builder, organized people manager, and committed youth development professional who can balance day-to-day program execution with staff development and long-term program growth. The Program Manager partners closely with Engagement Specialists, school administrators and faculty, and community partners to develop excellent service opportunities with buildOn students. Additionally, the Program Manager works closely with colleagues to plan and execute regional program events, and oversees and leads recruitment and support of students for Immersions (Trek, 36 Hours, and Partnership program) as well as special events. This is a great opportunity for a mission-driven leader who enjoys working with people and overseeing programs. If you have a history of leading successful teams with measurable results, then join buildOn as we continue to grow and change the world!

What You’ll Do

Lead a team of Student Engagement Specialists to engage students in buildOn’s service-learning program. This is not a remote position. Instead, it requires full-time activity in schools and in the community, coaching your team and serving alongside students and partners.

Direct Management

Directly supervise three Student Engagement Specialists responsible for supporting buildOn programming at the partner high schools.
Provide clear expectations, priorities, and accountability for program delivery, student engagement, school relationships, data management, and service-learning planning.
Conduct regular one-on-one meetings and team check-ins to monitor progress, identify challenges, and support staff success.
Build realistic work plans and schedules that enable Engagement Specialists to effectively balance student engagement, school responsibilities, service planning, administrative tasks, and community partnerships.

Coaching, Development & Accountability

Serve as a coach, role model, and accountability partner for Engagement Specialists, helping them strengthen their professional and program-management skills.
Conduct regular observations of Engagement Specialists using buildOn’s program quality standards and provide specific, actionable feedback.
Model strong professional habits, including proactive communication, timely follow-through, thoughtful planning, effective school partnership management, and accurate data entry.
Identify performance gaps early, establish clear expectations for improvement, and provide appropriate coaching and support.
Invest in the professional development and long-term growth of Engagement Specialists.

Program Quality & Methodology

Monitor the quality of programming delivered by Engagement Specialists and ensure alignment with buildOn’s service-learning methodology and Constructive Leadership framework.
Use student engagement data, observations, and staff feedback to identify program strengths, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
Support Engagement Specialists in developing high-quality service-learning experiences that center student voice, leadership, reflection, and community impact.

Relationship Building, Data Management & Cross-departmental Collaboration

Relationship Building

Maintain relationships with school partners in your portfolio (teaching advisors, principals, and administration) to ensure strong partnerships.
Meet and communicate regularly with school partners to highlight the success of the program and also troubleshoot any issues that arise in a timely manner.
Work with the Program Director, the Community Partnerships team, and Student Engagement Specialists to cultivate partnerships with local community-based organizations to increase meaningful opportunities for students to serve.

Data & Reporting

Use Salesforce to accurately track student engagement, service hours, and program participation.
Review engagement data regularly to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for program improvement.
Ensure timely completion of monthly engagement logs, surveys, and other MERL reporting requirements.
Use data to support staff accountability and inform program planning.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration

Work across departments to support organizational goals as one buildOn, including:
Marketing:
Share student stories, service highlights, and program successes.
Events:
Support student recruitment and participation in buildOn events and special opportunities.
Development:
Provide program and community partnership information to support grants and reporting.

What You Bring

Personal commitment to buildOn's mission — the power of service to change lives, communities, and the world. A demonstrated commitment to service in your own life.
Extensive experience living and/or working in underserved communities.
Commitment to creating programs for youth that are empowering and antiracist.
Demonstrated ability to use student engagement data (Key Performance Indicators) to increase engagement.
Flexible and able to manage the ambiguity and multiple priorities inherent in an entrepreneurial environment.
3+ years engaging youth in service learning.
1+ years managing high-performing teams (preferred).
Experience mentoring and/coaching a team.
Invested in continual growth and learning through ongoing discovery, planning and execution, and reflection.
Strong communicator with a track record of mentoring and coaching others to achieve results.
Relevant educational background.

What We Offer

When you join us in this movement, you’ll enjoy a rewarding career that provides you with the benefits and flexibility you need; while ensuring that you have the opportunity to learn and grow through annual performance reviews, opportunities for advancement and professional development opportunities.

Opportunity to connect and network with leaders of Fortune 500 organizations

100% insurance premium paid for medical, dental and vision along with subsidized deductibles.

Nous bâtissons des architectures ouvertes, performantes, souveraines et durables, pensées pour fluidifier et fiabiliser les échanges applicatifs critiques. Des modèles de données jusqu'aux interfaces inter-systèmes, nous posons des fondations solides pour les acteurs majeurs de l'industrie, du luxe, de la banque et du secteur public en Suisse romande.

La mission

Au Cœur D'un Projet De Modernisation Du Paysage Applicatif Pour Une Manufacture De Prestige Située Dans La Région Romande, Vous Faites Le Pont Stratégique Entre Les Métiers, Les Équipes Applicatives (ERP, CRM, PLM, E-commerce) Et Les Équipes D'intégration Technique. Vous Transformez Les Besoins Métier En Spécifications D'interfaces Claires, Robustes Et Pérennes. Votre Rôle S’articule En Trois Temps

Cadrer et cartographier
Animer les ateliers d’alignement avec les référents métiers et les Business Analysts applicatifs pour capter les besoins d’échange de données.
Cartographier l'écosystème de flux (sources, cibles, criticité, protocoles, volumétries et propriété de la donnée).
Veiller à l'intégrité et à l'alignement des données de référence (MDM : référentiels clients, articles, partenaires, distribution) en lien avec la gouvernance Data.
Spécifier et sécuriser
Rédiger les dossiers de spécifications technico-fonctionnelles détaillées des flux et APIs (mappings champ à champ, règles de transformation, gestion des rejets et reprises sur erreur).
Collaborer avec les architectes d'intégration sur les patterns cibles : APIs synchrones, flux asynchrones / événementiels, batchs, échanges de fichiers sécurisés ou EDI.
Rédiger les critères d'acceptation, concevoir les jeux de tests et piloter la recette d'intégration de bout en bout.
Faciliter et moderniser
Assurer le suivi et la fluidité des développements avec les équipes techniques en méthodologie Agile / Scrum.
Structurer la documentation des flux et préparer le passage de relais vers les équipes d'exploitation (MCO).
Utiliser les outils d'IA appliquée pour accélérer l'analyse, l'ingénierie de spécification et la génération de scénarios de test.

L'écosystème technique

Flux & Protocoles : APIs REST, SOAP, JSON, XML, CSV, formats EDI, flux asynchrones et événementiels (Kafka ou équivalent).
Plateformes & Middleware : Compréhension d'un ESB d'entreprise (notamment Talend ESB / DI, Apache Camel) et principes d'urbanisation de flux.
Modélisation & Analyse : BPMN, diagrammes de séquence, modèles conceptuels et logiques de données, SQL.
Écosystème Applicatif : Environnement ERP (idéalement SAP ECC ou S/4HANA) interconnecté à des outils spécialisés (CRM, PLM, MES, e-commerce).
Outillage & Qualité : Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, Jira, Confluence, Xray, outils d'IA générative.

Votre profil

Titulaire D’une Formation Supérieure En Informatique De Gestion, Systèmes D'information Ou Diplôme D'ingénieur (HES, EPFL, Université), Vous Justifiez D’au Moins 5 Ans D'expérience En Business Analysis, Dont 3 Ans Minimum Dédiés à Des Projets D'intégration Ou D'interfaçage Applicatif. On Parie Que Vous Cochez Aussi Ces Cases

Une solide pratique des projets d'intégration autour d'un ERP (SAP idéalement) et d'applications satellites.
Une excellente maîtrise de la modélisation de flux (BPMN), du SQL et de la formalisation de contrats d'interfaces (APIs, mapping).
Une expérience acquise dans un environnement exigeant (industrie, luxe, retail ou horlogerie).
Une grande aisance relationnelle pour animer des ateliers, vulgariser les contraintes techniques auprès du métier et challenger les choix fonctionnels.
Français courant obligatoire, avec un anglais professionnel opérationnel (niveau B2 minimum, C1 apprécié).

Pourquoi Synotis ?

Projets d'envergure : Vous intervenez au cœur de la transformation du SI d'une maison de référence, sur des flux à haute valeur ajoutée.
Équilibre & Cadre : Rythme de travail flexible avec télétravail partiel accordé.
Évolution continue : Parcours de formation sur-mesure, certifications reconnues (IIBA, Scrum, plateformes d'intégration) et veille technologique active (IA, gouvernance Data).
Synergie de groupe : L'esprit convivial d'une structure romande à taille humaine adossée à l'expertise technologique européenne du groupe Smile.

Les prochaines étapes

Premier contact : Échange téléphonique de découverte pour cerner vos aspirations et répondre à vos questions.
Entretien métier / méthodologique : Discussion autour de vos réalisations passées et cas pratiques de modélisation de flux.
Échange Direction : Rencontre dédiée à notre vision, vos perspectives d'évolution et nos valeurs d'équipe.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager, Senior
new_jobs.description:
Company Overview

Acentra Health exists to empower better health outcomes through technology, services, and clinical expertise. Our mission is to innovate health solutions that deliver maximum value and impact.

Lead the Way is our rallying cry at Acentra Health. Think of it as an open invitation to embrace the mission of the company; to actively engage in problem-solving; and to take ownership of your work every day. Acentra Health offers you unparalleled opportunities. In fact, you have all you need to take charge of your career and accelerate better outcomes - making this a great time to join our team of passionate individuals dedicated to being a vital partner for health solutions in the public sector.

At Acentra Health, we embrace emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence and advanced analytics that can be utilized to improve processes, enhance decision-making, and drive better health outcomes. We value professionals who are curious about new technologies and motivated to use innovative tools to increase efficiency, quality, and impact in their roles.

Job Summary And Responsibilities

Acentra Health is looking for a Project Manager, Senior to join our growing team.

Job Summary

The Senior Project Manager independently leads medium to large-scale healthcare and/or technology projects, ensuring delivery within defined scope, timeline, and budget. This role acts as a liaison with internal and external stakeholders, provides regular updates to clients and leadership, and proactively manages risks and resources to achieve project goals. The Senior Project Manager drives alignment between project execution and business objectives, prepares executive-level reporting, and mentors junior Project Managers and project coordinators to strengthen overall project.

Responsibilities

Manages end-to-end delivery of projects with moderate to high complexity, ensuring they are delivered on schedule, within scope, and on budget.
Leads cross-functional project teams and coordinates directly with clients on project activities, deliverables, and status updates.
Tracks milestones, deliverables, and metrics using project management tools such as Microsoft Project, EVM, and other reporting systems.
Manages project risks by identifying potential issues early, developing mitigation strategies, and escalating concerns when appropriate.
Supports alignment of project execution with broader business strategy and client objectives.
Prepares executive-level reports, conducts stakeholder presentations, and communicates effectively with senior leadership and clients.
Owns and monitors project budgets, forecasts resources, and collaborates with finance and leadership to manage project financials.
Ensures adherence to internal governance protocols, CMMI standards, and compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements.
Partners with clients to analyze problems, recommend solutions, and maintain strong client relationships throughout the project life cycle.
Confers with technical and functional personnel to resolve problems and ensure alignment between project goals and operational constraints.
Keeps project documentation current, including schedules, change requests, risks, issues, and lessons learned.
Leads or contributes to continuous improvement initiatives, recommending process and tool enhancements to improve delivery outcomes.
Mentors junior Project Managers, project coordinators, or team members by providing guidance, coaching, and knowledge sharing.
Demonstrates unwavering commitment to customer service, operational excellence, and longterm client success.
Maintains awareness of industry trends, technologies, and project management best practices to apply innovative approaches to delivery.
Read, understand, and adhere to all corporate policies including policies related to HIPAA and its Privacy and Security Rules.

The list of accountabilities is not intended to be all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other education- and experience-related duties that management may deem necessary from time to time.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, experience in lieu of a degree will be considered
5+ years of project management experience.
Experience with healthcare delivery systems, Medicaid/Medicare programs, or government contracts
Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Visio, SharePoint, PowerPoint); direct experience using Microsoft Project or similar tools required.

Additional Qualifications

PMP certification strongly preferred or actively working toward certification.
Advanced communication and negotiation skills.
Leadership and team-building capabilities.
Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple large-scale initiatives.

Why us?

We are a team of experienced and caring leaders, clinicians, pioneering technologists, and industry professionals who come together to redefine expectations for the healthcare industry. State and federal healthcare agencies, providers, and employers turn to us as their vital partner to ensure better healthcare and improve health outcomes.

We do this through our people.

You will have meaningful work that genuinely improves people's lives across the country. We are a company that cares about our employees, and we give you the tools and encouragement you need to achieve the finest work of your career.

Benefits

Benefits are a key component of your rewards package. Our benefits are designed to provide you with additional protection, security, and support for both your career and your life away from work. Our benefits include comprehensive health plans, paid time off, retirement savings, corporate wellness, educational assistance, corporate discounts, and more.

Thank You!

We know your time is valuable and we thank you for applying for this position. Due to the high volume of applicants, only those who are chosen to advance in our interview process will be contacted. We sincerely appreciate your interest in Acentra Health and invite you to apply to future openings that may be of interest. Best of luck in your search!

We are committed to providing a secure and positive hiring experience. Depending on the role, interviews may be conducted virtually, in person, or through a combination of both. As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be asked to participate in identity verification measures to help ensure the integrity of the hiring process.

~ The Acentra Health Talent Acquisition Team

Visit us at https://careers.acentra.com/jobs

EEO AA M/F/Vet/Disability

Acentra Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable Federal, State or Local law.

Experience In Lieu Of Degree

For non-clinical roles, or when not required by the contract specifically, the Company acknowledges that practical, hands-on experience can provide skills and competencies equivalent to formal education. As such, in cases where a Bachelor's degree may be required, the Company will accept a minimum of six (6) years of directly relevant professional experience in lieu of a degree. In instances where the candidate has an Associate's degree, the Company will accept a minimum of three (3) years of directly relevant professional experience in lieu of the Bachelor's degree.

Compensation

The pay for this position is listed below.

"Based on our compensation philosophy, an applicant’s position placement in the pay range will depend on various considerations, such as years of applicable experience and skill level."

Pay Range

USD $114,800.00 - USD $143,500.00 /Yr.

new_jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager (NSGS)
new_jobs.description:
Overview

GovCIO is seeking a Senior IT Project Manager
to support mission-critical infrastructure modernization programs for the U.S. Coast Guard (USCG). This position will serve as a key technical leader within the PMO, driving the concurrent execution of complex enterprise network tech refreshes, Out-of-Band (OOB) Management system deployments, and legacy VSAT replacement programs across USCG sites. This position will be a fully remote position.

Responsibilities

As a Senior IT Project Manager, you will serve as the primary leader responsible for the end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of complex IT infrastructure and enterprise network projects to ensure USCG mission success. You will coordinate closely with USCG stakeholders, cross-functional engineering teams, field technicians, and vendor partners to ensure smooth technology upgrades with minimal operational disruption. Key responsibilities include:

Lead, plan, and execute multiple parallel IT infrastructure projects from initiation through closure, focusing heavily on USCG network hardware refreshes, OOB management deployments, and legacy VSAT transitions.
Define project scope, build detailed work breakdown structures (WBS), maintain integrated master schedules, and proactively manage critical paths to prevent engineering and deployment bottlenecks.
Identify, track, and mitigate technical, logistical, and timeline risks early; develop comprehensive contingency plans to minimize network downtime during critical cutovers.
Serve as a primary point of contact for USCG leadership, technical leads, and third-party vendors, ensuring strict adherence to SLAs, delivery timelines, and military regulations.
Manage project budgets, track expenditures, forecast financial requirements, and coordinate procurement workflows for global network hardware and connectivity services.
Coordinate the allocation and daily tasks of network engineers, field technicians, site readiness coordinators, and security teams across various USCG deployment locations.
Quality-check and oversee the submission of all project deliverables, engineering documentation, change management tickets, and Monthly Status Reports (MSRs).
Drive operational efficiencies by implementing best practices in IT project management and aligning deployments with USCG and federal architecture standards.

Qualifications

Bachelor's (or equivalent) with 12+ years of experience.

Required Skills & Experience

Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent federal project management certification.
Proven experience managing large-scale federal contracts or enterprise IT infrastructure deployments, preferably within the DoD, DHS, or USCG environment.
Direct IT project management experience deploying Out-of-Band (OOB) Management architectures (e.g., Opengear, Perle, Cradlepoint) for remote network resilience.
Solid understanding of satellite communications, specifically managing legacy VSAT hardware replacements, link migrations, and troubleshooting circuit transitions.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with experience presenting technical deployment strategies and program status briefings to executive-level government stakeholders.
Proficiency in Microsoft Project, Excel (advanced formulas/pivots), and integrated PMO tools for tracking schedules, resource allocation, and performance.

Clearance Level: Must be able to attain and maintain a Public Trust

Preferred Skills And Experience

Technical certifications (e.g., CCNA, CCNP, ITIL) are a strong plus.
Direct experience supporting U.S. Coast Guard missions, specifically within C5I or similar technical network directorates.
Expert proficiency in Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid project management frameworks using Jira and Confluence.
Experience managing complex procurement cycles and vendor contracts for global telecommunications and network equipment.

Posted Salary Range: USD $140,000.00 - USD $160,000.00 /Yr.

new_jobs.title: Real Estate Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Who We Are:

Self-Help started in 1980 with a focus on economic inequality especially in communities that have faced systemic barriers in building wealth. At the core of what Self-Help does is a drive to create and protect ownership and economic opportunity. In other words, we’re committed to economic justice! Economic Justice means that all communities have the basic infrastructure they need to thrive, from high-quality schools to grocery stores selling fresh food resources that support opportunity at a neighborhood level regardless of demographics, income, or wealth. Since our founding, we’ve constantly sought to find new ways to pursue greater economic justice: from providing fair and affordable loans to working with partners to demand that lawmakers change unjust policies.

We are seeking a Real Estate Project Manager to join our team in Los Angeles, CA!

Please note:
The successful candidate may be hired into a more senior role based on relevant experience, expertise and demonstrated qualifications.

What You'll Do

Actively participate in identifying and evaluating potential properties for acquisition, including project idea conceptualization for both commercial and residential real estate.
Perform detailed site analysis, including studying site constraints, zoning and entitlement requirements, and producing back of the envelope financial models.
Develop complex pro formas that often utilize layered financing, including sources such as New Markets Tax Credits, Historic Tax Credits, Low Income Housing Tax Credits, and more.
Perform market research to analyze project economics and verify assumptions used in pro forma models.
Actively manage the property acquisition due diligence and closing process, including coordinating with third parties such as surveyors, attorneys, and environmental consultants.
Research existing community planning documents and participate in community groups and neighborhood discussions to listen, learn, and build long-term individual and organizational relationships.

DEVELOPMENT

Coordinate internal project team meetings, which typically include construction managers, leasing staff, and other Self-Help staff.
Over time, build relationships with community members and stakeholders, including neighborhood leaders, property owners, government staff, and elected officials.
Assist with the preparation and presentation of investment memoranda to secure Self-Help and third-party financing.
Review and comment on legal documents such as leases, loan agreements, and other financing documents.
Actively support the process of closing financing, including managing checklists, reviewing key documents, analyzing financial projections, and coordinating with financing partners.
Work closely with external design and construction teams, alongside construction management colleagues.
Monitor development budgets and project timelines.
Communicate clearly and consistently with development partners, including tenants, community members, and more.
Assist with leasing and other activities needed to complete and stabilize development projects.

ASSET MANAGEMENT

Assist with internal and external reporting requirements for projects underway and post completion.
Assist with other asset management tasks as needed in coordination with colleagues.

Other

Act as a change agent to drive Self-Help’s economic inclusion initiatives by integrating supplier diversity and the use of businesses owned by women and people of color in third party contracting and vendor management for relevant products and services.
Participate in other special projects as needed, in order to support the Real Estate team.
Mentor newer and/or younger project management staff.
Manage project management interns as needed.

What You'll Need

BA/BS degree in Real Estate, Business, Urban Planning, Finance, Public Policy, Public Administration, Community Development or related field. Master’s degree in one of these fields strongly preferred.
5 years of relevant work experience in real estate development, project management, finance, community development or related field, with Master’s degree in related field of study partially counting toward this requirement.
Significant experience with review of contracts, grant agreements, legal documents, or other demonstrations of legal reasoning.
Some experience with negotiation and ability for strategic thinking.
Prior supervisory experience preferred.
Strong commitment to our mission – creating economic opportunity for traditionally underserved communities.
Preference for working in organizations that place priority on teamwork and collaboration
Commitment to social and economic justice.
Sensitivity to issues of low-wealth communities and a desire to work in culturally and socially diverse organization that strongly values collaboration.
Ability to demonstrate Self-Help's Core Values:
Mission Before Self
Service With Excellence
Embracing & Promoting Change
Results Not Credit
Diversity as Strength
Financial Sustainability for Mission Impact

Self-Help is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

La mission requiert un Project Manager capable de piloter des projets de transformation opérationnelle de bout en bout et d'assurer la représentation des Opérations sur des projets transverses initiés par le Business ou l'IT. new_jobs.title: Principal Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

The Global PMO Program Manager is responsible for leading complex, cross-functional transformation programs from strategy and planning through implementation and value realization. The role will initially focus on the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) transformation within Digital Core ERP transformation, providing end-to-end program leadership across integrated planning, governance, risk and dependency management, stakeholder alignment, vendor coordination, and execution.

Working across business, engineering, technology, operations, and external partners, the Program Manager will establish the structure and operating rhythm necessary to deliver programs on time, within budget, and against defined business outcomes. The role will proactively manage risks and issues, drive decisions and accountability, coordinate interdependent workstreams, and provide clear visibility of program health and performance to senior stakeholders.

As part of the Global PMO, the Program Manager will champion delivery excellence, scalable program management practices, and modern approaches to program execution, including effective use of data, automation, and AI.

GE HealthCare is a $20B publicly traded global med-tech company focused on diagnostic and digital solutions. With more than 50,000 employees across 160+ countries, GE HealthCare serves over 1 billion patients worldwide. Founded in 2023 as a spin-off from GE, we combine a strong heritage of innovation with the agility of a new growth-oriented public company.

Job Description

The PLM assignment will include leading transformation across engineering and product lifecycle processes, process standardization and adoption, product and master data readiness, data governance, testing and deployment readiness, and business value realization. Experience leading large-scale global transformations is essential, with PLM, engineering transformation, product data, and PTC Windchill experience strongly preferred.

Roles and Responsibilities

Ensures successful, end-to-end delivery of a project or a program through ongoing client engagement, partnering with technical teams internal and external to the initiative, and coordination of all required activities and milestones. Involved in projects prioritization and initiation, responsible for definition of and compliance with project management methodologies, performing regular tracking and reporting on progress, and accountable for initiative results verification.
Requires specialized knowledge within the function. Influence the development of strategy for the area of responsibility, including control of resources and influences policy formulation.
Interprets simple internal and external business challenges and recommends best practices to improve products, processes or services. Stays informed of industry trends that may inform work.
Uses high level of judgment to make decisions and handle complex tasks or problems in areas of operational, product management, manufacturing, technology or engineering. Has ability to assess quality of information given and ask pertinent questions to stakeholders. Able to offer new solutions to problems outside of set parameters and is able to construct and provide recommendations. Uses multiple internal and some external sources outside of own function to help arrive at a decision.

new_jobs.title: Senior Cryogenic Business Development & Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.

That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum's most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas Zennström.

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have the funding, the government validation, and the sites under construction to make it real.

Job Summary

PsiQuantum's Photonics & Technologies group turns the company's core platforms into commercial products. The Cryogenic Interconnect business line brings our data-center-grade cryogenics to AI rack-scale interconnect.

Turns PsiQuantum's cryogenic capabilities into customer programs — and delivers them.
PsiQuantum is the only company bringing data-center-grade cryogenics to AI infrastructure. This role works directly with customers to find where cryogenic operation solves their problems in interconnect reach, cooling density and next-generation architecture; shapes those opportunities into programs; and then manages those programs from first hardware through qualification into production.

Responsibilities

Identify and develop opportunities where PsiQuantum's cryogenic capabilities — data-center-grade cryostats, thermal containment, warm-to-cold interfaces — solve AI data center problems, across interconnect, cooling and future rack architectures.
Convert opportunities into programs: scope, phase structure, statements of work, acceptance criteria and pricing.
Manage those programs end to end with customer and internal teams.
Coordinate joint demonstrations and qualification gates across internal engineering, customer deliverables and external suppliers.

Experience/Qualifications

10+ years spanning business development and program management for datacenter, networking or complex hardware systems, with 3+ years running customer-funded co-development or NPI programs through qualification into production.
Commercial fluency in co-development structures: SOWs, phased POs, acceptance gates, production frameworks, take-or-pay and capacity reservation terms.
Technically credible: can hold a room on thermal budgets, qualification criteria and schedule risk without an interpreter.
Experience coordinating across a customer, contract fabricators and long-lead suppliers simultaneously.
Comfort developing programs for a product that is still being defined, where the specification and the schedule move together.

new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Overview

Keysight is a mission-critical design enablement partner for organizations solving the world’s most complex engineering challenges. With deep engineering expertise and leading design, emulation, and test solutions, our ~16,800 employees help customers in over 100 countries accelerate innovation across communications, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace and defense, semiconductor, and artificial intelligence markets. Learn more about what we do.

At Keysight, people come together to explore new ideas, challenge what's possible, and advance the technologies defining the future. Here, you'll find opportunities to do your best work, take your career further, and thrive in an award-winning culture. Learn more about our benefits.

Responsibilities

The Wireless IST team is seeking a proactive Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead complex, cross-functional hardware programs from concept through customer delivery in a fast-moving environment with high customer expectations. You will own the end-to-end Keysight program for a leading global technology customer whose priorities can evolve quickly and who expects speed, adaptability, and clear communication from its partners.

You will lead through engineering managers and program managers across functions and work directly with the customer to drive schedules, risks, communication, and alignment across R&D, IST, manufacturing, supply chain, support, and customer teams. You will deliver integrated systems that meet stringent performance and qualification requirements, building structure where processes, templates, or governance are still being developed without slowing execution.

Key Responsibilities

Program Leadership and Execution

Lead end-to-end planning and execution across R&D, IST, manufacturing, supply chain, support, and customer teams.
Serve as the primary program interface to the customer TPM, internal leadership, and engineering organizations.
Align cross-functional leaders on requirements, priorities, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and milestones, and drive accountability for customer commitments.
Listen closely across teams and the customer, clarify implied concerns, connect information to surface risks and dependencies early, and track past decisions and commitments to maintain alignment.

Scheduling Risk and Documentation

Maintain the integrated master schedule, critical path, dependencies, and resource plan.
Maintain a risk register with clear owners, mitigation plans, and closure timelines.
Keep program documentation, including statement of work (SOW) deliverables, plans, reports, action logs, and decision records, current and accessible.
Coordinate development, integration, validation, manufacturing readiness, and customer deployment.

Reporting and Communication

Deliver weekly internal status updates covering progress, risks, issues, decisions, and next steps.
Provide monthly program reports for leadership and the customer covering milestones, critical path status, forecasted dates, accomplishments, and risks with mitigation plans.
Develop executive-ready dashboards and presentations, and communicate issues with root causes, impacts, and recovery plans.

Customer Engagement

Partner closely with customer TPMs to clarify requirements, review progress, and address escalations.
Facilitate program reviews, milestone checkpoints, demonstrations, and acceptance activities.
Build trust through proactive communication and expectation management so commitments are realistic, documented, aligned with internal schedules, and consistently met.

Process and Governance

Establish lightweight program governance for milestone reviews, risk management, escalation, and change control, adding structure where it helps teams move faster or avoid surprises.
Drive continuous improvement of processes, tools, and reporting, and support portfolio planning and cross-program coordination.

Qualifications

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
5–8+ years of experience in technical program management or engineering leadership.
Demonstrated success leading complex hardware, software, or integrated system programs.
Proven success in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, ideally supporting a demanding enterprise or hyperscale customer, including building processes from the ground up.
Exceptional listening, synthesis, and recall skills, with the ability to interpret explicit and implied concerns, draw sound conclusions, and accurately track decisions and commitments.
Excellent organizational, problem-solving, risk management, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong understanding of product development lifecycles, system integration, validation, and manufacturing readiness, with experience across R&D, manufacturing, and supply chain.
Experience managing multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities and aggressive schedules.
Proficiency with Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, or similar tools.
PMP certification or equivalent.

Preferred Qualifications

Customer-facing leadership experience, including executive-level communication, reporting, and escalation management.
Experience in high-tech industries such as wireless, satellite, networking, or test and measurement.

Success Measures

On-time delivery of customer milestones, commitments, and deliverables.
Clear, timely documentation and reporting.
Effective management of risks, issues, scope changes, and resource constraints.
Strong cross-functional alignment and customer satisfaction.
Predictable execution, with risks surfaced early and commitments kept accurate.
